create table import_batches (
  id                  uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  kind                text not null check (kind = 'permit_updates'),
  source_name         text not null,
  source_sha256       text not null check (source_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  payload_fingerprint text not null check (payload_fingerprint ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  status              text not null check (status = 'completed'),
  row_count           int not null check (row_count > 0),
  actor               uuid not null references profiles(id),
  created_at          timestamptz not null default now(),
  completed_at        timestamptz not null,
  error_summary       text,
  unique (kind, source_sha256)
);

alter table import_batches enable row level security;

create policy import_batches_read_she on import_batches for select to authenticated
using (
  has_role(array['she_staff']::app_role[])
  and exists (select 1 from profiles where id = auth.uid() and active)
);

create or replace function admin_import_permit_updates(p_envelope jsonb) returns uuid
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
declare
  v_actor uuid := auth.uid();
  v_source_name text;
  v_source_sha256 text;
  v_rows jsonb;
  v_payload_fingerprint text;
  v_existing import_batches%rowtype;
  v_row jsonb;
  v_row_number int;
  v_keys text[];
  v_seen jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  v_key text;
  v_batch_id uuid;
begin
  if v_actor is null or not exists (
    select 1
    from profiles profile
    join role_assignments assignment on assignment.user_id = profile.id
    where profile.id = v_actor
      and profile.active
      and assignment.role = 'she_staff'
      and assignment.scope = 'company'
  ) then
    raise exception '활성 SHE팀 담당자만 인허가를 일괄 반영할 수 있습니다.' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if jsonb_typeof(p_envelope) is distinct from 'object' then
    raise exception '가져오기 요청은 JSON 객체여야 합니다.';
  end if;

  select array_agg(key order by key) into v_keys from jsonb_object_keys(p_envelope) key;
  if v_keys is distinct from array['rows', 'source_name', 'source_sha256']::text[] then
    raise exception '가져오기 요청 필드가 계약과 일치하지 않습니다.';
  end if;

  if jsonb_typeof(p_envelope -> 'source_name') is distinct from 'string'
     or btrim(p_envelope ->> 'source_name') = ''
     or length(p_envelope ->> 'source_name') > 255 then
    raise exception 'source_name은 1자 이상 255자 이하 문자열이어야 합니다.';
  end if;
  if jsonb_typeof(p_envelope -> 'source_sha256') is distinct from 'string'
     or (p_envelope ->> 'source_sha256') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' then
    raise exception 'source_sha256은 소문자 64자리 SHA-256이어야 합니다.';
  end if;
  if jsonb_typeof(p_envelope -> 'rows') is distinct from 'array'
     or jsonb_array_length(p_envelope -> 'rows') = 0 then
    raise exception 'rows는 한 행 이상의 JSON 배열이어야 합니다.';
  end if;

  v_source_name := p_envelope ->> 'source_name';
  v_source_sha256 := p_envelope ->> 'source_sha256';
  v_rows := p_envelope -> 'rows';
  v_payload_fingerprint := encode(extensions.digest(v_rows::text, 'sha256'), 'hex');

  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('permit_updates:' || v_source_sha256, 0));
  select * into v_existing
  from import_batches
  where kind = 'permit_updates' and source_sha256 = v_source_sha256;

  if found then
    if v_existing.source_name is distinct from v_source_name
       or v_existing.payload_fingerprint is distinct from v_payload_fingerprint then
      raise exception '같은 원본 해시에 파일명 또는 인허가 내용이 다른 요청이 제출되었습니다.';
    end if;
    return v_existing.id;
  end if;

  for v_row, v_row_number in
    select value, ordinality::int from jsonb_array_elements(v_rows) with ordinality
  loop
    if jsonb_typeof(v_row) is distinct from 'object' then
      raise exception '데이터 %행은 JSON 객체여야 합니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;
    select array_agg(key order by key) into v_keys from jsonb_object_keys(v_row) key;
    if v_keys is distinct from array[
      'applicable', 'authority', 'conditions', 'detail', 'grade', 'issued_on',
      'items', 'permit_no', 'permit_type', 'quantity', 'site_code', 'status'
    ]::text[] then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 필드가 계약과 일치하지 않습니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;

    if jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'site_code') is distinct from 'string'
       or btrim(v_row ->> 'site_code') = ''
       or jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'permit_type') is distinct from 'string'
       or jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'applicable') is distinct from 'boolean'
       or jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'status') is distinct from 'string' then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 필수 값 형식이 올바르지 않습니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;

    if (v_row ->> 'permit_type') not in (select unnest(enum_range(null::permit_type))::text)
       or (v_row ->> 'status') not in (select unnest(enum_range(null::permit_status))::text) then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 인허가 유형 또는 상태가 허용되지 않습니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;

    if exists (
      select 1
      from unnest(array['grade', 'detail', 'permit_no', 'authority', 'conditions']) field
      where jsonb_typeof(v_row -> field) not in ('string', 'null')
    ) then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 선택 문자열 형식이 올바르지 않습니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;
    if exists (
      select 1
      from unnest(array['grade', 'detail', 'permit_no', 'authority', 'conditions']) field
      where jsonb_typeof(v_row -> field) = 'string' and btrim(v_row ->> field) = ''
    ) then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 선택 문자열은 비어 있거나 공백만 포함할 수 없습니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;

    if jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'items') is distinct from 'array'
       or exists (
         select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(v_row -> 'items') item
         where jsonb_typeof(item) is distinct from 'string' or btrim(item #>> '{}') = ''
       ) then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 대상 항목은 빈 값이 없는 문자열 배열이어야 합니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;

    if jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'quantity') not in ('number', 'null')
       or (
         jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'quantity') = 'number'
         and (
           (v_row ->> 'quantity') !~ '^-?(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$'
           or (v_row ->> 'quantity')::numeric not between -2147483648 and 2147483647
         )
       ) then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 수량은 32비트 정수 또는 null이어야 합니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;

    if jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'issued_on') not in ('string', 'null') then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 발급일은 유효한 YYYY-MM-DD 또는 null이어야 합니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;
    if jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'issued_on') = 'string' then
      if (v_row ->> 'issued_on') !~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' then
        raise exception '데이터 %행의 발급일은 유효한 YYYY-MM-DD 또는 null이어야 합니다.', v_row_number;
      end if;
      begin
        perform (v_row ->> 'issued_on')::date;
      exception
        when datetime_field_overflow or invalid_datetime_format then
          raise exception '데이터 %행의 발급일은 유효한 YYYY-MM-DD 또는 null이어야 합니다.', v_row_number;
      end;
    end if;

    v_key := (v_row ->> 'site_code') || chr(31) || (v_row ->> 'permit_type');
    if v_seen ? v_key then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 사업장·인허가 유형이 중복되었습니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;
    v_seen := v_seen || jsonb_build_object(v_key, true);

    if not exists (select 1 from sites where code = v_row ->> 'site_code') then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 사업장 코드가 등록되지 않았습니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;
    if not exists (
      select 1
      from site_permits permit
      join sites site on site.id = permit.site_id
      where site.code = v_row ->> 'site_code'
        and permit.permit_type::text = v_row ->> 'permit_type'
    ) then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 인허가 대상이 존재하지 않습니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;
  end loop;

  for v_row in select value from jsonb_array_elements(v_rows)
  loop
    update site_permits permit
    set applicable = (v_row ->> 'applicable')::boolean,
        grade = case when jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'grade') = 'string' then v_row ->> 'grade' else permit.grade end,
        detail = case when jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'detail') = 'string' then v_row ->> 'detail' else permit.detail end,
        items = case
          when jsonb_array_length(v_row -> 'items') > 0
            then array(select item #>> '{}' from jsonb_array_elements(v_row -> 'items') item)
          else permit.items
        end,
        quantity = case when jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'quantity') = 'number' then (v_row ->> 'quantity')::int else permit.quantity end,
        permit_no = case when jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'permit_no') = 'string' then v_row ->> 'permit_no' else permit.permit_no end,
        authority = case when jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'authority') = 'string' then v_row ->> 'authority' else permit.authority end,
        issued_on = case when jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'issued_on') = 'string' then (v_row ->> 'issued_on')::date else permit.issued_on end,
        conditions = case when jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'conditions') = 'string' then v_row ->> 'conditions' else permit.conditions end,
        status = (v_row ->> 'status')::permit_status,
        source = 'import:' || v_source_name || ':' || v_source_sha256,
        updated_by = v_actor,
        updated_at = now()
    from sites site
    where site.id = permit.site_id
      and site.code = v_row ->> 'site_code'
      and permit.permit_type::text = v_row ->> 'permit_type';
  end loop;

  insert into import_batches (
    kind, source_name, source_sha256, payload_fingerprint, status,
    row_count, actor, completed_at, error_summary
  ) values (
    'permit_updates', v_source_name, v_source_sha256, v_payload_fingerprint, 'completed',
    jsonb_array_length(v_rows), v_actor, now(), null
  ) returning id into v_batch_id;

  return v_batch_id;
end
$$;

revoke all on function admin_import_permit_updates(jsonb) from public;
revoke all on function admin_import_permit_updates(jsonb) from anon;
grant execute on function admin_import_permit_updates(jsonb) to authenticated;
create view v_admin_permit_status with (security_invoker = true) as
with evidence as (
  select distinct attachment.entity_id
  from attachments attachment
  join storage.objects object
    on object.bucket_id = 'evidence'
   and object.name = attachment.storage_path
  where attachment.entity_type = 'permit'
)
select permit.id as permit_id,
       site.id as site_id,
       site.code as site_code,
       site.name as site_name,
       division.code as division_code,
       division.name as division_name,
       permit.permit_type::text as permit_type,
       case permit.permit_type
         when 'air_emission' then '대기 배출시설'
         when 'air_prevention' then '대기 방지시설'
         when 'fugitive_dust' then '비산먼지 발생사업'
         when 'air_monitoring' then '대기 측정기기'
         when 'water_emission' then '폐수 배출시설'
         when 'nonpoint_source' then '비점오염원'
         when 'river_water_use' then '하천수 사용'
         when 'waste_general' then '일반폐기물'
         when 'waste_designated' then '지정폐기물'
         when 'soil_specific' then '특정토양오염관리대상시설'
         when 'noise_vibration' then '소음·진동 배출시설'
         when 'groundwater' then '지하수 이용'
         when 'chemical' then '화학물질 취급시설'
       end as permit_type_name,
       permit.applicable,
       permit.grade,
       permit.permit_no,
       permit.authority,
       permit.issued_on,
       permit.status::text as status,
       case permit.status
         when 'active' then '유효'
         when 'pending' then '확인 대기'
         when 'revoked' then '폐지'
         when 'unknown' then '미확인'
       end as status_name,
       permit.source,
       evidence.entity_id is not null as has_evidence,
       permit.status = 'unknown'
         or (
           permit.applicable
           and permit.permit_no is null
           and permit.authority is null
           and permit.issued_on is null
         ) as needs_review,
       permit.updated_at
from site_permits permit
join sites site on site.id = permit.site_id
join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
left join evidence on evidence.entity_id = permit.id;

create view v_admin_obligation_status with (security_invoker = true) as
with evidence as (
  select distinct attachment.entity_id
  from attachments attachment
  join storage.objects object
    on object.bucket_id = 'evidence'
   and object.name = attachment.storage_path
  where attachment.entity_type = 'obligation_task'
)
select task.id as task_id,
       site.id as site_id,
       site.code as site_code,
       site.name as site_name,
       division.code as division_code,
       division.name as division_name,
       type.code as obligation_type_code,
       type.title as obligation_title,
       task.period_label,
       task.due_date,
       task.due_date - (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date as d_day,
       task.status::text as status,
       case
         when task.status = 'planned' and task.due_date < (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date then '기한 경과'
         when task.status = 'planned' and task.due_date <= (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date + 30 then '기한 임박'
         when task.status = 'planned' then '계획'
         when task.status = 'done' then '이행 완료'
         when task.status = 'confirmed' then '확인 완료'
         when task.status = 'waived' then '면제'
       end as status_name,
       task.status = 'planned'
         and task.due_date < (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date as overdue,
       type.evidence_required,
       evidence.entity_id is not null as has_evidence,
       task.done_on,
       task.done_by,
       task.confirmed_by,
       task.confirmed_at
from obligation_tasks task
join obligation_types type on type.code = task.type_code
join sites site on site.id = task.site_id
join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
left join evidence on evidence.entity_id = task.id;

create view v_admin_era_status with (security_invoker = true) as
with item_counts as (
  select item.assessment_id,
         count(*) filter (where item.significant) as significant_item_count,
         count(*) filter (where item.needs_improvement) as improvement_item_count
  from era_items item
  group by item.assessment_id
),
evidence as (
  select distinct attachment.entity_id
  from attachments attachment
  join storage.objects object
    on object.bucket_id = 'evidence'
   and object.name = attachment.storage_path
  where attachment.entity_type = 'era_assessment'
)
select assessment.id as assessment_id,
       site.id as site_id,
       site.code as site_code,
       site.name as site_name,
       division.code as division_code,
       division.name as division_name,
       assessment.year as assessment_year,
       assessment.revision,
       assessment.template_id,
       assessment.status::text as status,
       case assessment.status
         when 'draft' then '초안'
         when 'submitted' then '제출'
         when 'reviewed' then '검토 완료'
         when 'approved' then '승인'
         when 'returned' then '반려'
       end as status_name,
       coalesce(item_counts.significant_item_count, 0) as significant_item_count,
       coalesce(item_counts.improvement_item_count, 0) as improvement_item_count,
       evidence.entity_id is not null as has_evidence,
       assessment.author_id,
       assessment.submitted_at,
       assessment.reviewed_at,
       assessment.approved_at,
       assessment.created_at
from era_assessments assessment
join sites site on site.id = assessment.site_id
join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
left join item_counts on item_counts.assessment_id = assessment.id
left join evidence on evidence.entity_id = assessment.id;

create view v_admin_action_status with (security_invoker = true) as
with evidence as (
  select distinct attachment.entity_id
  from attachments attachment
  join storage.objects object
    on object.bucket_id = 'evidence'
   and object.name = attachment.storage_path
  where attachment.entity_type in ('action_before', 'action_after')
)
select action.id as action_id,
       site.id as site_id,
       site.code as site_code,
       site.name as site_name,
       division.code as division_code,
       division.name as division_name,
       action.source_type::text as source_type,
       case action.source_type
         when 'era' then '환경영향평가'
         when 'finding' then '점검 지적'
         when 'incident' then '환경 사고'
         when 'obligation' then '의무 이행'
         when 'other' then '기타'
       end as source_type_name,
       action.source_id,
       action.title,
       action.owner_id,
       action.owner_name,
       action.due_date,
       action.due_date - (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date as d_day,
       action.status::text as status,
       case action.status
         when 'open' then '미착수'
         when 'in_progress' then '진행 중'
         when 'done' then '완료'
         when 'closed' then '종결'
         when 'returned' then '반려'
       end as status_name,
       action.status in ('open', 'in_progress', 'returned')
         and action.due_date < (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date as overdue,
       action.confirmed_by is not null and action.confirmed_at is not null as manager_confirmed,
       action.status = 'closed' and action.closed_by is not null and action.closed_at is not null as closed,
       evidence.entity_id is not null as has_evidence,
       action.created_at
from actions action
join sites site on site.id = action.site_id
join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
left join evidence on evidence.entity_id = action.id;

create view v_admin_data_quality with (security_invoker = true) as
with obligation_evidence as (
  select distinct attachment.entity_id
  from attachments attachment
  join storage.objects object
    on object.bucket_id = 'evidence'
   and object.name = attachment.storage_path
  where attachment.entity_type = 'obligation_task'
),
accessible_sites as (
  select site.id, site.code, site.name, site.division_code
  from sites site
),
unverified_obligations as (
  select 'obligation-type:' || type.code as issue_id,
         'warning'::text as severity,
         'unverified_legal_duty'::text as category,
         'obligation_type'::text as entity_type,
         type.code as source_id,
         null::uuid as site_id,
         null::text as site_code,
         null::text as site_name,
         null::text as division_code,
         null::text as division_name,
         '미검증 법적 의무'::text as summary,
         concat_ws(' · ', type.title, type.legal_basis, type.notes) as detail
  from obligation_types type
  where not type.verified
    and exists (select 1 from accessible_sites)
),
permit_issues as (
  select 'site-permit:' || permit.id::text || ':' ||
           case when permit.status = 'unknown' then 'unknown' else 'missing' end as issue_id,
         'warning'::text as severity,
         case when permit.status = 'unknown' then 'unknown_permit_status' else 'missing_permit_data' end as category,
         'site_permit'::text as entity_type,
         permit.id::text as source_id,
         site.id as site_id,
         site.code as site_code,
         site.name as site_name,
         division.code as division_code,
         division.name as division_name,
         case when permit.status = 'unknown' then '인허가 상태 미확인' else '인허가 필수정보 확인 필요' end as summary,
         concat_ws(' · ', permit.permit_type::text, permit.source) as detail
  from site_permits permit
  join accessible_sites site on site.id = permit.site_id
  join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
  where permit.status = 'unknown'
     or (
       permit.applicable
       and permit.permit_no is null
       and permit.authority is null
       and permit.issued_on is null
     )
),
obligation_missing_evidence as (
  select 'obligation-task:' || task.id::text || ':missing-evidence' as issue_id,
         'error'::text as severity,
         'missing_evidence'::text as category,
         'obligation_task'::text as entity_type,
         task.id::text as source_id,
         site.id as site_id,
         site.code as site_code,
         site.name as site_name,
         division.code as division_code,
         division.name as division_name,
         '의무 이행 증빙 누락'::text as summary,
         type.title || ' · 기한 ' || task.due_date::text as detail
  from obligation_tasks task
  join obligation_types type on type.code = task.type_code
  join accessible_sites site on site.id = task.site_id
  join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
  left join obligation_evidence evidence on evidence.entity_id = task.id
  where type.evidence_required
    and task.status <> 'waived'
    and task.due_date <= (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date
    and evidence.entity_id is null
),
obligation_overdue as (
  select 'obligation-task:' || task.id::text || ':overdue' as issue_id,
         'error'::text as severity,
         'overdue_obligation'::text as category,
         'obligation_task'::text as entity_type,
         task.id::text as source_id,
         site.id as site_id,
         site.code as site_code,
         site.name as site_name,
         division.code as division_code,
         division.name as division_name,
         '의무 이행 기한 경과'::text as summary,
         type.title || ' · ' || ((now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date - task.due_date)::text || '일 경과' as detail
  from obligation_tasks task
  join obligation_types type on type.code = task.type_code
  join accessible_sites site on site.id = task.site_id
  join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
  where task.status = 'planned'
    and task.due_date < (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date
),
obligation_incomplete as (
  select 'obligation-task:' || task.id::text || ':incomplete' as issue_id,
         'warning'::text as severity,
         'incomplete_obligation'::text as category,
         'obligation_task'::text as entity_type,
         task.id::text as source_id,
         site.id as site_id,
         site.code as site_code,
         site.name as site_name,
         division.code as division_code,
         division.name as division_name,
         '의무 이행 확인 미완료'::text as summary,
         type.title || ' · 이행 완료 후 공장장 확인 필요' as detail
  from obligation_tasks task
  join obligation_types type on type.code = task.type_code
  join accessible_sites site on site.id = task.site_id
  join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
  where task.status = 'done'
),
action_overdue as (
  select 'action:' || action.id::text || ':overdue' as issue_id,
         'error'::text as severity,
         'overdue_action'::text as category,
         'action'::text as entity_type,
         action.id::text as source_id,
         site.id as site_id,
         site.code as site_code,
         site.name as site_name,
         division.code as division_code,
         division.name as division_name,
         '조치 기한 경과'::text as summary,
         action.title || ' · ' || ((now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date - action.due_date)::text || '일 경과' as detail
  from actions action
  join accessible_sites site on site.id = action.site_id
  join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
  where action.status in ('open', 'in_progress', 'returned')
    and action.due_date < (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date
),
action_incomplete as (
  select 'action:' || action.id::text || ':incomplete' as issue_id,
         'warning'::text as severity,
         'incomplete_action'::text as category,
         'action'::text as entity_type,
         action.id::text as source_id,
         site.id as site_id,
         site.code as site_code,
         site.name as site_name,
         division.code as division_code,
         division.name as division_name,
         '조치 확인 또는 종결 미완료'::text as summary,
         action.title || ' · 현재 상태 ' || action.status::text as detail
  from actions action
  join accessible_sites site on site.id = action.site_id
  join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
  where action.status = 'done'
     or (action.status <> 'closed' and action.confirmed_at is not null)
)
select * from unverified_obligations
union all select * from permit_issues
union all select * from obligation_missing_evidence
union all select * from obligation_overdue
union all select * from obligation_incomplete
union all select * from action_overdue
union all select * from action_incomplete;

revoke all on v_admin_permit_status from public, anon;
revoke all on v_admin_obligation_status from public, anon;
revoke all on v_admin_era_status from public, anon;
revoke all on v_admin_action_status from public, anon;
revoke all on v_admin_data_quality from public, anon;

grant select on v_admin_permit_status to authenticated;
grant select on v_admin_obligation_status to authenticated;
grant select on v_admin_era_status to authenticated;
grant select on v_admin_action_status to authenticated;
grant select on v_admin_data_quality to authenticated;
# 관리용 뷰 데이터 사전

이 문서는 내부 운영자가 Supabase REST 또는 CSV로 내보내는 다섯 개 관리용 뷰의 고정 계약을 설명한다. 모든 뷰는 PostgreSQL `security_invoker = true`이며 로그인 사용자의 기반 테이블 RLS 범위를 그대로 적용한다. 익명 사용자는 조회할 수 없고, 역할이 없는 로그인 사용자는 0건을 조회한다.

## 공통 규칙

- 조직 식별자는 `site_id` UUID와 사람이 읽는 `site_code`, `site_name`, `division_code`, `division_name`을 함께 제공한다.
- 원시 상태는 `status`, 한글 표시 상태는 `status_name`이다. 자동화와 필터에는 원시 상태를 사용한다.
- `d_day`는 `기한일 - Asia/Seoul 기준 오늘`인 정수다. 양수는 남은 일수, 0은 당일, 음수는 경과 일수다.
- 기한 컬럼은 기반 테이블에서 필수이므로 현재 `d_day`는 `null`이 되지 않는다. `d_day < 0`이어도 완료·확인·면제·종결 상태라면 `overdue`는 `false`일 수 있다.
- `has_evidence`는 `attachments` 행과 private `evidence` Storage의 실제 객체가 같은 경로로 연결될 때만 `true`다. 첨부 메타데이터만 있거나 Storage 객체가 없으면 증빙으로 인정하지 않는다.
- 모든 `*_id`, `source_id`는 원본 업무를 다시 조회하는 감사·드릴다운 식별자다. `v_admin_data_quality.source_id`만 여러 원본 키 형식을 담기 위해 `text`다.

## `v_admin_permit_status`

사업장별 인허가 적용 여부, 종별, 확인 필요 데이터와 실제 증빙 연결 여부를 조회한다.

| 순서 | 컬럼 | 형식 | 의미 |
| ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `permit_id` | `uuid` | `site_permits.id` |
| 2 | `site_id` | `uuid` | 사업장 UUID |
| 3 | `site_code` | `text` | 사업장 코드 |
| 4 | `site_name` | `text` | 사업장명 |
| 5 | `division_code` | `text` | 부문 코드 |
| 6 | `division_name` | `text` | 부문명 |
| 7 | `permit_type` | `text` | 인허가 종별 원시 코드 |
| 8 | `permit_type_name` | `text` | 인허가 종별 한글명 |
| 9 | `applicable` | `boolean` | 사업장 적용 여부 |
| 10 | `grade` | `text` | 종별·등급 |
| 11 | `permit_no` | `text` | 허가·신고 번호 |
| 12 | `authority` | `text` | 허가·신고 기관 |
| 13 | `issued_on` | `date` | 발급일 |
| 14 | `status` | `text` | 원시 상태 |
| 15 | `status_name` | `text` | 한글 상태 |
| 16 | `source` | `text` | 입력 출처 |
| 17 | `has_evidence` | `boolean` | 실제 Storage 객체와 연결된 인허가 증빙 존재 여부 |
| 18 | `needs_review` | `boolean` | 상태가 미확인이거나 적용 대상의 번호·기관·발급일이 모두 없는 경우 |
| 19 | `updated_at` | `timestamptz` | 마지막 변경 시각 |

인허가 종별 표시는 다음과 같다.

| 코드 | 한글 표시 |
| --- | --- |
| `air_emission` | 대기 배출시설 |
| `air_prevention` | 대기 방지시설 |
| `fugitive_dust` | 비산먼지 발생사업 |
| `air_monitoring` | 대기 측정기기 |
| `water_emission` | 폐수 배출시설 |
| `nonpoint_source` | 비점오염원 |
| `river_water_use` | 하천수 사용 |
| `waste_general` | 일반폐기물 |
| `waste_designated` | 지정폐기물 |
| `soil_specific` | 특정토양오염관리대상시설 |
| `noise_vibration` | 소음·진동 배출시설 |
| `groundwater` | 지하수 이용 |
| `chemical` | 화학물질 취급시설 |

상태 표시는 `active`=유효, `pending`=확인 대기, `revoked`=폐지, `unknown`=미확인이다.

## `v_admin_obligation_status`

검증을 거쳐 생성된 의무 이행 일정만 조회한다. 미검증 의무 정의는 이 뷰에 일정으로 나타나지 않는다.

| 순서 | 컬럼 | 형식 | 의미 |
| ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `task_id` | `uuid` | `obligation_tasks.id` |
| 2–6 | `site_id`, `site_code`, `site_name`, `division_code`, `division_name` | `uuid`, `text` | 조직 식별자와 표시명 |
| 7 | `obligation_type_code` | `text` | 의무 정의 코드 |
| 8 | `obligation_title` | `text` | 의무명 |
| 9 | `period_label` | `text` | 대상 기간 |
| 10 | `due_date` | `date` | 이행 기한 |
| 11 | `d_day` | `integer` | 기한일에서 서울 기준 오늘을 뺀 값 |
| 12 | `status` | `text` | 원시 상태 |
| 13 | `status_name` | `text` | 한글 표시 상태 |
| 14 | `overdue` | `boolean` | `planned`이며 기한이 지난 경우 |
| 15 | `evidence_required` | `boolean` | 의무 정의상 증빙 필수 여부 |
| 16 | `has_evidence` | `boolean` | 실제 Storage 객체와 연결된 증빙 존재 여부 |
| 17 | `done_on` | `date` | 이행일 |
| 18 | `done_by` | `uuid` | 이행 등록자 |
| 19 | `confirmed_by` | `uuid` | 확인자 |
| 20 | `confirmed_at` | `timestamptz` | 확인 시각 |

상태 표시는 `planned` 중 기한 경과=기한 경과, 30일 이내=기한 임박, 그 외=계획이며 `done`=이행 완료, `confirmed`=확인 완료, `waived`=면제다.

## `v_admin_era_status`

사업장별 환경영향평가 차수와 유의·개선 필요 항목 수를 조회한다. 항목 집계는 첨부 수와 무관하게 평가 한 건당 한 행이다.

| 순서 | 컬럼 | 형식 | 의미 |
| ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `assessment_id` | `uuid` | `era_assessments.id` |
| 2–6 | `site_id`, `site_code`, `site_name`, `division_code`, `division_name` | `uuid`, `text` | 조직 식별자와 표시명 |
| 7 | `assessment_year` | `integer` | 평가 연도 |
| 8 | `revision` | `integer` | 차수 |
| 9 | `template_id` | `uuid` | 사용 템플릿 UUID |
| 10 | `status` | `text` | 원시 상태 |
| 11 | `status_name` | `text` | 한글 표시 상태 |
| 12 | `significant_item_count` | `bigint` | 유의 항목 수 |
| 13 | `improvement_item_count` | `bigint` | 개선 필요 항목 수 |
| 14 | `has_evidence` | `boolean` | 실제 Storage 객체와 연결된 평가 증빙 존재 여부 |
| 15 | `author_id` | `uuid` | 작성자 |
| 16 | `submitted_at` | `timestamptz` | 제출 시각 |
| 17 | `reviewed_at` | `timestamptz` | 검토 시각 |
| 18 | `approved_at` | `timestamptz` | 승인 시각 |
| 19 | `created_at` | `timestamptz` | 생성 시각 |

상태 표시는 `draft`=초안, `submitted`=제출, `reviewed`=검토 완료, `approved`=승인, `returned`=반려다.

## `v_admin_action_status`

조치의 출처, 담당자, 기한 경과, 공장장 확인과 종결 여부를 조회한다.

| 순서 | 컬럼 | 형식 | 의미 |
| ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `action_id` | `uuid` | `actions.id` |
| 2–6 | `site_id`, `site_code`, `site_name`, `division_code`, `division_name` | `uuid`, `text` | 조직 식별자와 표시명 |
| 7 | `source_type` | `text` | 원시 출처 코드 |
| 8 | `source_type_name` | `text` | 출처 한글명 |
| 9 | `source_id` | `uuid` | 출처 업무 UUID. 출처가 없는 수동 조치는 `null` 가능 |
| 10 | `title` | `text` | 조치명 |
| 11 | `owner_id` | `uuid` | 담당자 UUID |
| 12 | `owner_name` | `text` | 담당자명 |
| 13 | `due_date` | `date` | 조치 기한 |
| 14 | `d_day` | `integer` | 기한일에서 서울 기준 오늘을 뺀 값 |
| 15 | `status` | `text` | 원시 상태 |
| 16 | `status_name` | `text` | 한글 표시 상태 |
| 17 | `overdue` | `boolean` | 미착수·진행 중·반려 상태에서 기한이 지난 경우 |
| 18 | `manager_confirmed` | `boolean` | 공장장 확인자와 확인 시각이 모두 존재하는지 여부 |
| 19 | `closed` | `boolean` | 종결 상태이며 종결자와 종결 시각이 모두 존재하는지 여부 |
| 20 | `has_evidence` | `boolean` | 실제 Storage 객체와 연결된 조치 전·후 증빙 존재 여부 |
| 21 | `created_at` | `timestamptz` | 생성 시각 |

출처 표시는 `era`=환경영향평가, `finding`=점검 지적, `incident`=환경 사고, `obligation`=의무 이행, `other`=기타다. 상태 표시는 `open`=미착수, `in_progress`=진행 중, `done`=완료, `closed`=종결, `returned`=반려다.

## `v_admin_data_quality`

운영자가 원본을 찾아 보완할 수 있는 품질 이슈만 제공한다. 이 뷰의 판단은 법률 자문이나 법적 적합성 결론이 아니다.

| 순서 | 컬럼 | 형식 | 의미 |
| ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `issue_id` | `text` | 범주와 원본 키를 결합한 안정적인 이슈 키 |
| 2 | `severity` | `text` | `warning` 또는 `error` |
| 3 | `category` | `text` | 조치 가능한 이슈 범주 |
| 4 | `entity_type` | `text` | 원본 엔터티 종류 |
| 5 | `source_id` | `text` | 원본 UUID 문자열 또는 의무 정의 코드 |
| 6–10 | `site_id`, `site_code`, `site_name`, `division_code`, `division_name` | `uuid`, `text` | 사업장 이슈의 조직 정보. 전역 의무 정의 이슈는 `null` |
| 11 | `summary` | `text` | 짧은 한글 조치 요약 |
| 12 | `detail` | `text` | 원본 확인에 필요한 설명 |

지원 범주는 다음과 같다.

| 범주 | 의미 |
| --- | --- |
| `unverified_legal_duty` | 원문·주기·적용 조건 확인 전인 의무 정의. 일정이나 법적 결론으로 해석하지 않는다. |
| `unknown_permit_status` | 인허가 상태 미확인 |
| `missing_permit_data` | 적용 대상인데 번호·기관·발급일이 모두 비어 있음 |
| `missing_evidence` | 기한이 도래한 증빙 필수 의무에 실제 Storage 증빙이 없음 |
| `overdue_obligation` | 계획 상태의 의무 이행 기한 경과 |
| `incomplete_obligation` | 이행 완료 후 확인 미완료 |
| `overdue_action` | 미착수·진행 중·반려 조치의 기한 경과 |
| `incomplete_action` | 완료 후 확인 또는 종결 미완료 |

미검증 의무는 `site_id`가 없는 정의 품질 이슈 한 건으로만 표시하며 `obligation_tasks` 생성 여부나 특정 사업장 적용 여부를 뜻하지 않는다. 사업장 정보가 있는 이슈는 로그인 사용자의 사업장 RLS 범위만 표시된다.

## CSV와 Excel 사용

1. 로그인한 사용자의 JWT로 REST 조회하거나 Supabase Studio에서 뷰를 조회한다.
2. 열 순서는 이 문서의 순서를 유지하고 CSV는 UTF-8 BOM으로 저장한다.
3. Excel에서는 **데이터 → 텍스트/CSV에서** 파일을 열고 인코딩을 UTF-8로 확인한다. 파일을 더블클릭하면 일부 Excel 버전에서 한글이나 날짜 형식이 바뀔 수 있다.
4. `site_code`, `permit_no`, `source_id`, 모든 UUID 열은 텍스트 형식으로 가져온다. 특히 앞자리 0이 가능한 허가번호를 숫자로 변환하지 않는다.
5. 날짜는 ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`, 시각은 시간대가 포함된 ISO 값으로 유지한다. 표시 서식이 바뀌어도 원본 CSV 값을 덮어쓰지 않는다.
6. 내보낸 CSV는 조회용 산출물이다. 상태 변경이나 운영 데이터 적재에 다시 사용하지 않는다.

REST 예시는 `GET /rest/v1/v_admin_permit_status?select=*&order=site_code,permit_type` 형식이다. 같은 토큰이라도 역할 범위에 따라 사업장 담당자는 1개 사업장, 실무부서장은 소속 부문, SHE팀 담당은 전사 범위만 조회한다.

## 법적 사용 주의

법령 기반 의무의 `verified=false`, 데이터 품질 경고, D-day와 상태 표시는 내부 확인 우선순위를 돕는 운영 정보다. 법적 의무의 성립, 신고 필요성, 제출 기한 또는 준수 여부를 확정하는 법률 판단으로 사용하지 않는다. 원문과 최신 행정기관 지침을 담당자가 별도로 확인하고 검증 기록을 남긴 뒤에만 자동 일정을 생성한다.
# 인허가 변경 CSV 템플릿

`permit_updates.csv`를 복사해 `imports/private/` 아래에서 작성한 뒤 다음 명령으로 먼저 검증합니다.

```powershell

```

이 명령은 파일과 기준 사업장 목록만 읽습니다. 데이터베이스에 연결하거나 파일을 변경하지 않습니다.

헤더는 템플릿과 순서까지 정확히 같아야 합니다. 필수 열은 `site_code`, `permit_type`, `applicable`, `status`입니다.
빈 칸과 공백만 넣은 칸은 서로 다르게 오류로 보고됩니다.

| 열 | 입력값 |
| --- | --- |
| `site_code` | `seed/sites.csv`에 있는 사업장 코드. 예: `RMC-01` |
| `permit_type` | 영문 코드. 예: `air_emission`, `waste_general` |
| `applicable` | `true` 또는 `false` |
| `grade`, `detail`, `items`, `quantity` | 선택값. `items`는 `|`로 구분하며 `quantity`는 -2147483648 이상 2147483647 이하 정수 |
| `permit_no`, `authority`, `conditions` | 선택값 |
| `issued_on` | 선택값. 입력 시 `YYYY-MM-DD` |
| `status` | `active`, `pending`, `revoked`, `unknown` 중 하나 |

빈 선택 열은 기존 값을 유지합니다. 선택 값을 지우려면 CSV 대량 반영이 아니라 별도 관리 절차를 사용합니다.

import csv
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

import openpyxl

from .models import SeedIssue


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class CsvRecord:
    """One raw CSV data row and its spreadsheet-style row number."""

    row: int
    values: dict[str, str | None]


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class CsvReadResult:
    """Parsed CSV records and header-level issues."""

    records: tuple[CsvRecord, ...]
    issues: tuple[SeedIssue, ...]


def read_csv(path: Path, required_headers: tuple[str, ...]) -> CsvReadResult:
    """Read one master CSV with BOM support, retaining raw cell distinctions."""
    try:
        with path.open(encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as handle:
            reader = csv.DictReader(handle)
            headers = tuple(reader.fieldnames or ())
            missing = tuple(header for header in required_headers if header not in headers)
            if missing:
                return CsvReadResult(
                    records=(),
                    issues=(
                        SeedIssue(path.name, 1, "headers", ",".join(missing), "required headers are missing"),
                    ),
                )
            records = tuple(
                CsvRecord(row=index, values={key: value for key, value in record.items() if key is not None})
                for index, record in enumerate(reader, start=2)
            )
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return CsvReadResult(
            records=(),
            issues=(SeedIssue(path.name, 0, "file", None, "required input file is missing"),),
        )
    return CsvReadResult(records=records, issues=())


def read_excel_rows(path: Path, sheet_name: str) -> tuple[tuple[str | None, ...], ...]:
    """Read Excel cells without leaking workbook objects into seed validation."""
    workbook = openpyxl.load_workbook(path, data_only=True, read_only=True)
    sheet = workbook[sheet_name]
    rows = tuple(
        tuple(None if cell.value is None else str(cell.value) for cell in row)
        for row in sheet.iter_rows()
    )
    workbook.close()
    return rows

    "era_template_items.csv": ("division", "seq", "process", "activity", "aspect", "impact", "media", "condition", "legal_related", "likelihood", "severity"),
}


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _ParsedRecord[T]:
    row: int
    value: T


def _empty_issues(file_name: str, record: CsvRecord, required: tuple[str, ...]) -> tuple[SeedIssue, ...]:
    """Return distinct empty and whitespace-only diagnostics for required cells."""
    issues: list[SeedIssue] = []
    for field in required:
        value = record.values.get(field)
        if value == "":
            issues.append(SeedIssue(file_name, record.row, field, value, "required value is empty"))
        elif value is not None and value.strip() == "":
            issues.append(SeedIssue(file_name, record.row, field, value, "required value is whitespace only"))
    return tuple(issues)


def _normalized(values: dict[str, str | None]) -> dict[str, str | None]:
    """Normalize optional text after empty-vs-whitespace validation has run."""
    normalized: dict[str, str | None] = {}
    for key, value in values.items():
        if value is None:
            normalized[key] = None
        else:
            trimmed = value.strip()
            normalized[key] = trimmed or None
    return normalized


def _model_issues(
    file_name: str,
    row: int,
    error: ValidationError,
    values: dict[str, str | None],
) -> tuple[SeedIssue, ...]:
    """Convert Pydantic diagnostics into stable operator-facing issues."""
    return tuple(
        SeedIssue(file_name, row, str(detail["loc"][0]), values.get(str(detail["loc"][0])), detail["msg"])
        for detail in error.errors()
    )


def _parse_csv[T](
    root: Path,
    file_name: str,
    model: Callable[..., T],
) -> tuple[tuple[_ParsedRecord[T], ...], tuple[SeedIssue, ...]]:
    """Read and parse one CSV master using its model constructor."""
    result = read_csv(root / file_name, REQUIRED_HEADERS[file_name])
    issues = list(result.issues)
    rows: list[_ParsedRecord[T]] = []
    for record in result.records:
        empties = _empty_issues(file_name, record, REQUIRED_FIELDS[file_name])
        issues.extend(empties)
        try:
            parsed = model(**_normalized(record.values))
            if not empties:
                rows.append(_ParsedRecord(record.row, parsed))
        except ValidationError as error:
            issues.extend(_model_issues(file_name, record.row, error, record.values))
    return tuple(rows), tuple(issues)


def _json_issue(root: Path) -> tuple[tuple[ApprovalRule, ...], tuple[SeedIssue, ...]]:
    """Parse approval rules separately from CSV master inputs."""
    path = root / "approval_rules.json"
    try:
        return TypeAdapter(tuple[ApprovalRule, ...]).validate_json(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")), ()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return (), (SeedIssue(path.name, 0, "file", None, "required input file is missing"),)
    except ValidationError as error:
        return (), (SeedIssue(path.name, 1, "json", None, str(error)),)


def _json_columns(rows: tuple[_ParsedRecord[ObligationRow], ...]) -> tuple[SeedIssue, ...]:
    """Validate JSON string columns before SQL rendering."""
    issues: list[SeedIssue] = []
    for record in rows:
        for field, value in (("due_rule", record.value.due_rule), ("applies_when", record.value.applies_when)):
            try:
                json.loads(value)
            except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
                issues.append(SeedIssue("obligation_types.csv", record.row, field, value, error.msg))
    return tuple(issues)


def _duplicate_field_issues(
    file_name: str,
    records: tuple[CsvRecord, ...],
    field: str,
    message: str,
) -> tuple[SeedIssue, ...]:
    seen: set[str] = set()
    issues: list[SeedIssue] = []
    for record in records:
        value = (record.values.get(field) or "").strip()
        if value in seen:
            issues.append(SeedIssue(file_name, record.row, field, value, message))
        seen.add(value)
    return tuple(issues)


def _unknown_site_issues(
    sites: tuple[CsvRecord, ...],
    permits: tuple[CsvRecord, ...],
) -> tuple[SeedIssue, ...]:
    known_sites = {(record.values.get("code") or "").strip() for record in sites}
    return tuple(
        SeedIssue("site_permits.csv", record.row, "site_code", code, "unknown site code")
        for record in permits
        if (code := (record.values.get("site_code") or "").strip()) not in known_sites
    )


def _duplicate_permit_key_issues(records: tuple[CsvRecord, ...]) -> tuple[SeedIssue, ...]:
    seen: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
    issues: list[SeedIssue] = []
    for record in records:
        key = (
            (record.values.get("site_code") or "").strip(),
            (record.values.get("permit_type") or "").strip(),
        )
        if key in seen:
            issues.append(
                SeedIssue(
                    "site_permits.csv",
                    record.row,
                    "site_code,permit_type",
                    ",".join(key),
                    "duplicate site permit key",
                )
            )
        seen.add(key)
    return tuple(issues)


def _duplicate_era_key_issues(records: tuple[CsvRecord, ...]) -> tuple[SeedIssue, ...]:
    seen: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
    issues: list[SeedIssue] = []
    for record in records:
        key = ((record.values.get("division") or "").strip(), (record.values.get("seq") or "").strip())
        if key in seen:
            issues.append(SeedIssue("era_template_items.csv", record.row, "division,seq", ",".join(key), "duplicate ERA template key"))
        seen.add(key)
    return tuple(issues)


def _duplicate_approval_issues(approvals: tuple[ApprovalRule, ...]) -> tuple[SeedIssue, ...]:
    seen: set[str] = set()
    issues: list[SeedIssue] = []
    for index, rule in enumerate(approvals, start=1):
        if rule.code in seen:
            issues.append(SeedIssue("approval_rules.json", index, "code", rule.code, "duplicate approval rule code"))
        seen.add(rule.code)
    return tuple(issues)

# 관리용 뷰 데이터 사전

이 문서는 내부 운영자가 Supabase REST 또는 CSV로 내보내는 다섯 개 관리용 뷰의 고정 계약을 설명한다. 모든 뷰는 PostgreSQL `security_invoker = true`이며 로그인 사용자의 기반 테이블 RLS 범위를 그대로 적용한다. 익명 사용자는 조회할 수 없고, 역할이 없는 로그인 사용자는 0건을 조회한다.

## 공통 규칙

- 조직 식별자는 `site_id` UUID와 사람이 읽는 `site_code`, `site_name`, `division_code`, `division_name`을 함께 제공한다.
- 원시 상태는 `status`, 한글 표시 상태는 `status_name`이다. 자동화와 필터에는 원시 상태를 사용한다.
- `d_day`는 `기한일 - Asia/Seoul 기준 오늘`인 정수다. 양수는 남은 일수, 0은 당일, 음수는 경과 일수다.
- 기한 컬럼은 기반 테이블에서 필수이므로 현재 `d_day`는 `null`이 되지 않는다. `d_day < 0`이어도 완료·확인·면제·종결 상태라면 `overdue`는 `false`일 수 있다.
- `has_evidence`는 `attachments` 행과 private `evidence` Storage의 실제 객체가 같은 경로로 연결될 때만 `true`다. 첨부 메타데이터만 있거나 Storage 객체가 없으면 증빙으로 인정하지 않는다.
- 모든 `*_id`, `source_id`는 원본 업무를 다시 조회하는 감사·드릴다운 식별자다. `v_admin_data_quality.source_id`만 여러 원본 키 형식을 담기 위해 `text`다.

| `missing_evidence` | 기한이 도래한 증빙 필수 의무에 실제 Storage 증빙이 없음 |
| `overdue_obligation` | 계획 상태의 의무 이행 기한 경과 |
| `incomplete_obligation` | 이행 완료 후 확인 미완료 |
| `overdue_action` | 미착수·진행 중·반려 조치의 기한 경과 |
| `incomplete_action` | 완료 후 확인 또는 종결 미완료 |

미검증 의무는 `site_id`가 없는 정의 품질 이슈 한 건으로만 표시하며 `obligation_tasks` 생성 여부나 특정 사업장 적용 여부를 뜻하지 않는다. 사업장 정보가 있는 이슈는 로그인 사용자의 사업장 RLS 범위만 표시된다.

## CSV와 Excel 사용

1. 로그인한 사용자의 JWT로 REST 조회하거나 Supabase Studio에서 뷰를 조회한다.
2. 열 순서는 이 문서의 순서를 유지하고 CSV는 UTF-8 BOM으로 저장한다.
3. Excel에서는 **데이터 → 텍스트/CSV에서** 파일을 열고 인코딩을 UTF-8로 확인한다. 파일을 더블클릭하면 일부 Excel 버전에서 한글이나 날짜 형식이 바뀔 수 있다.
4. `site_code`, `permit_no`, `source_id`, 모든 UUID 열은 텍스트 형식으로 가져온다. 특히 앞자리 0이 가능한 허가번호를 숫자로 변환하지 않는다.
5. 날짜는 ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`, 시각은 시간대가 포함된 ISO 값으로 유지한다. 표시 서식이 바뀌어도 원본 CSV 값을 덮어쓰지 않는다.
6. 내보낸 CSV는 조회용 산출물이다. 상태 변경이나 운영 데이터 적재에 다시 사용하지 않는다.

REST 예시는 `GET /rest/v1/v_admin_permit_status?select=*&order=site_code,permit_type` 형식이다. 같은 토큰이라도 역할 범위에 따라 사업장 담당자는 1개 사업장, 실무부서장은 소속 부문, SHE팀 담당은 전사 범위만 조회한다.

## 법적 사용 주의

법령 기반 의무의 `verified=false`, 데이터 품질 경고, D-day와 상태 표시는 내부 확인 우선순위를 돕는 운영 정보다. 법적 의무의 성립, 신고 필요성, 제출 기한 또는 준수 여부를 확정하는 법률 판단으로 사용하지 않는다. 원문과 최신 행정기관 지침을 담당자가 별도로 확인하고 검증 기록을 남긴 뒤에만 자동 일정을 생성한다.
# 인허가 변경 CSV 템플릿

`permit_updates.csv`를 복사해 `imports/private/` 아래에서 작성한 뒤 다음 명령으로 먼저 검증합니다.


이 명령은 파일과 기준 사업장 목록만 읽습니다. 데이터베이스에 연결하거나 파일을 변경하지 않습니다.

헤더는 템플릿과 순서까지 정확히 같아야 합니다. 필수 열은 `site_code`, `permit_type`, `applicable`, `status`입니다.

# Data Operations final integrated review

Reviewed range: `60e93dfb81435cd92281ab7a950aa3af57b2ad45..3b7f3130e5b4cff7e7dd1a823ccd69bf4019a173`

Sources reviewed: the Data Operations plan, `docs/spec/11_backend_mvp.md`, role/data-model specs, the SDD ledger, every task review, Auth-fixture review, and Task 1–4 evidence artifacts. This is a whole-plan interface/security review; findings already closed by the scoped re-reviews are not repeated.

## Verdict

**BLOCK**

## Critical

None.

## Important

1. **CSV validation accepts quantities that the transactional RPC must reject.** `scripts/importer/validate.py:104-111` accepts every value understood by Python `int`, and `scripts/importer/models.py:25` places no 32-bit bound on `quantity`. The database boundary correctly rejects values outside signed 32-bit range at `supabase/migrations/0011_import_batches.sql:146-154`. Reproduction at reviewed HEAD: a valid-shape row with `quantity=2147483648` returned `issues=()` and a parsed update with that value; an apply must then fail at the RPC. Thus `validate` and `apply --dry-run` can approve a file that `apply` rejects, contrary to the plan's already-validated-plan boundary and the requested Task 2/Task 3 semantic match. Add the database range to the Python model/parser and regress both `2147483647`/`-2147483648` success and one-step overflow failure.

2. **The CLI discards the RPC's actionable row/field failure information.** `scripts/importer/transaction.py:199-206` maps every non-success response—including the deliberately specific validation and authorization exceptions raised by `0011_import_batches.sql`—to the same `Supabase 인허가 반영 요청에 실패했습니다.` message. `scripts/importer/cli.py:52-54` can consequently print only that generic text. For database drift, a missing target, an inactive caller, or any direct RPC prevalidation failure, the operator receives no target or reason even though `docs/spec/11_backend_mvp.md:91,193-194` requires actionable error results and says database failures must not be hidden. Preserve credential redaction, but parse a narrowly typed PostgREST error response and surface only the safe server message/code; add a mock-response regression and a real RPC denial/validation assertion.

3. **Pre-existing RLS helpers do not deactivate a user's read scope, and the new administrative views inherit that behavior.** This root cause predates the reviewed range: `supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql:102-129` derives site access solely from `role_assignments`, without requiring `profiles.active`. The five `security_invoker` views at `supabase/migrations/0012_admin_views.sql:1-358` correctly preserve those policies, but an inactive profile with a still-valid JWT and retained role assignment therefore keeps its site/division/company view access. Task 3 explicitly checks active profiles at `supabase/migrations/0011_import_batches.sql:43-52`, so mutation and import-audit access are protected; general administrative reads are not. This is an integrated security dependency rather than a regression introduced by Data Operations, but it prevents a whole-system active-user guarantee. Harden the common read helpers/policies and add inactive-user assertions for all five views.

## Minor

None.

## Confirmed integrated behavior

- Typed seed generation preserves the checked-in SQL byte-for-byte and the authoritative `23/299/22/18` counts; the plan's `18 obligation types` text is correctly treated as a plan defect.
- Task 1 enums feed Task 2 models, and Task 2 emits the exact row keys/types expected by Task 3. Required `applicable`/`status`, optional blank-preserve behavior, dates, item arrays, site/permit keys, source byte hashing, replay fingerprinting, advisory-lock concurrency, rollback, and audit triggers are otherwise aligned.
- Import authorization is limited to active company-scoped `she_staff`; the function has a fixed search path and restricted execute grant. Normal CLI operation uses an anon/publishable project key plus a user JWT, not service-role credentials. No tracked access token or project secret was found.
- Import batches are RLS-protected, exact-byte SHA and typed-payload provenance are bound by the CLI/RPC contract, and exact replay does not overwrite later edits.
- All five views are `security_invoker`, retain site RLS through joins/CTEs, use real attachment-plus-Storage-object evidence, and expose stable drill-down identifiers. Unverified obligation definitions appear only as global quality findings and do not create schedules or legal conclusions.
- Migration/test numbering (`0011`/`0012`, tests `08`/`09`) is consistent with the existing repository sequence. Document-ingestion tables/contracts remain unobstructed.

Reviewed only `3b7f3130e5b4cff7e7dd1a823ccd69bf4019a173..e4e708d56c02eabc7cc020701bfffcf0f216b394` against the three Important findings above and the final-fix ledger/evidence.

### Prior findings

1. **Int32 CSV/RPC semantics — ADDRESSED.** `scripts/importer/models.py:12-14,28` defines and enforces the signed PostgreSQL `int` bounds at the typed model boundary. `scripts/importer/validate.py:110-120` reports an operator-facing quantity issue before constructing an update. `tests/importer/test_permit_updates.py:185-235` covers both exact bounds, one-step underflow/overflow, empty updates on failure, and nonzero dry-run behavior. The README now documents the same range. No cast or validation escape hatch was introduced.

2. **Actionable but redacted PostgREST failures — ADDRESSED.** `scripts/importer/postgrest_errors.py:6-22,42-61` accepts only the expected `P0001`, `P0002`, and `42501` codes through a strict four-field response model, bounded printable Korean messages, and explicit URL/credential/SQL/schema fragment rejection. `scripts/importer/transaction.py:199-218` surfaces only that safe projection and retains the generic response for all other HTTP/parse failures. `tests/importer/test_postgrest_errors.py:45-122` covers useful denial output plus hostile, malformed, unknown-code, control-character, and oversized responses. The real JWT/CLI evidence shows the intended Korean `42501` reason and no token/project-key leak.

3. **Active-profile enforcement — NOT ADDRESSED.** The new helpers correctly add `profiles.active` to site, scoped-role, and company-role checks (`supabase/migrations/0013_active_profile_access.sql:1-47`), and `10_active_profile_access.test.sql` proves inactive reads/capabilities disappear and 1/14/23 scopes return after administrator-driven reactivation. However, the fix leaves the pre-existing self-update policy at `supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql:741` unchanged: any authenticated user may update their own entire `profiles` row with only `id = auth.uid()` as `USING`/`WITH CHECK`. Direct reproduction on the migrated database: after an administrator set the site officer inactive, the same authenticated identity executed `update profiles set active=true where id=auth.uid() returning active`, received `true`, and `my_site_ids()` immediately returned one site again. A deactivated company SHE user can likewise restore all 23-site access and master-write capability. The new 45-contract test never attempts self-reactivation, so the same-JWT deactivation evidence does not establish durable revocation. Restrict self-service updates to approved non-security columns (or guard `active` changes to authorized administration) and add site/company self-reactivation denial tests.

### New Critical / Important regressions

No additional Critical or Important regression was found beyond the unresolved active-profile bypass above.

### Scoped verdict

## Targeted self-reactivation hotfix re-review

Reviewed only `e4e708d56c02eabc7cc020701bfffcf0f216b394..feb3d85dca0d6e3239274666cba76f8975d10f5c` against the remaining active-profile self-reactivation finding and the hotfix ledger/evidence.

### Remaining finding

**Active-profile self-reactivation — ADDRESSED.** `supabase/migrations/0014_profile_self_update_guard.sql:1-25` adds an invoker-context `before update` trigger that permits ordinary authenticated self-service only when `id`, `email`, `active`, and `created_at` remain unchanged. A protected-field change is allowed only when `has_role(she_staff)` succeeds, which already requires an active company-scoped assignment; therefore an inactive user and a self-deactivated SHE user cannot regain access, while an active company SHE administrator can deactivate or reactivate another profile. The table RLS policy still confines non-SHE callers to their own row.

`supabase/tests/11_profile_self_update_guard.test.sql:24-110` directly covers retained-JWT self-reactivation denial, zero post-denial scope, harmless `name`/`phone`/`title` self-service, denial of `id`/`email`/`active`/`created_at` changes, active SHE administration of another profile, exact scope restoration, and denial after SHE self-deactivation. The actual REST evidence independently observes HTTP 403/`42501`, zero rows across all five views plus sites and Storage, successful harmless self-service, administrator reactivation, and exact `13/1/1/1/30 + sites 1 + storage 1` scope restoration with the same JWT.

Trigger security is appropriate: `0014_profile_self_update_guard.sql:2-3,28-32` is not security-definer, fixes `search_path` to `public, pg_temp`, schema-qualifies the authorization helper/type, revokes direct execution from `public`, `anon`, and `authenticated`, and installs one enabled row trigger. Runtime catalog verification showed `prosecdef=false`, `search_path=public, pg_temp`, no anon/authenticated execute privilege, and trigger state `O` (enabled). The remaining service-role execute ACL is consistent with that already-privileged administrative role and does not give application identities a callable surface.

### New Critical / Important regressions

None found.

- `git diff --check e4e708d..feb3d85`: clean.

### Final hotfix verdict

Reviewed range: `60e93dfb81435cd92281ab7a950aa3af57b2ad45..9b1fc3983f7d09f0d404c85424d51f595a5d19ff`.

Inputs consulted: Task 1 in `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-03-data-operations.md`, `docs/spec/11_backend_mvp.md`, the SDD ledger, and `.omo/evidence/data_ops_task1.md`.

## Findings

### CRITICAL

1. **Generated seed changes an existing persisted value instead of preserving the checked-in seed semantics.** `render_sql.py:75` emits `{division} ERA 평가 템플릿(초안)`, whereas checked-in `supabase/seed.sql` inserts `{division} ERA 표준 템플릿 (초안)`. Running the builder produced a different hash (`EFD3…244C` vs checked-in `6FDF…B890`) and a direct SQL diff shows all three `era_templates.title` values change. This violates Task 1's requirement to preserve the checked-in seed semantics; a reset using the regenerated file creates different master data. Restore the original titles/spacing and add a regression that compares the generated seed's parsed effects (or a checked-in golden SQL with only explicitly non-semantic formatting excluded) to the checked-in seed.

### IMPORTANT

1. **Missing source files crash validation instead of producing collectable `SeedIssue`s.** `readers.py:30` directly opens each CSV, and `validators.py:91-95` directly reads the JSON without `FileNotFoundError` handling. Calling `validate_seed()` on an empty directory, or one with only `sites.csv`, raises before it can report all missing files. Task 1 specifically requires missing-file/header validation and collecting all issues without writes. Convert each absent required input into a typed issue and continue across every input.

2. **Malformed JSON row numbers become incorrect after an earlier invalid row.** `validators.py:105` derives CSV row numbers by enumerating only successfully parsed `ObligationRow`s. If CSV row 2 has an invalid enum and row 3 has malformed `due_rule`, row 3's JSON problem is reported as row 2 (reproduced with a CSV writer fixture). Preserve the original `CsvRecord.row` beside each parsed obligation so JSON diagnostics remain accurate, 1-based source locations.

3. **Only duplicate site codes are validated; primary/unique keys in the other masters are accepted and later fail in PostgreSQL.** `_relations()` at `validators.py:114-129` has no duplicate checks for `obligation_types.code`, `approval_rules.code`, or the logical `(division, seq)` identity of ERA template items. In particular `approval_rules.code` is the primary key used by `approval_records`, and `obligation_types.code` is the primary key. A fixture with two identical approval codes returns `()` from `validate_seed()`. Validate every seed master key before rendering so invalid input does not reach the DB.

4. **The deterministic-rendering test does not protect source-semantic preservation.** `tests/seed_builder/test_render_sql.py:7-22` compares two executions of the same renderer, so it remains green when a renderer literal changes every generated title (as the critical finding demonstrates). Add an independent expected semantic assertion/golden comparison for the checked-in master data, including SQL/JSON/array escaping behavior, rather than deriving both sides from `build_seed()`.

### MINOR

1. **The type-check configuration suppresses the requested public-boundary safety signal.** `pyproject.toml:20-32` uses `typeCheckingMode = "standard"` and disables `reportAny`/unknown-type diagnostics. No direct `Any`, `cast`, or `type: ignore` was found in the task diff, and public functions are annotated, but this configuration would not reliably catch a future violation of the plan's prohibition. Use the repository's strict expected mode or at least do not silence these diagnostics.

  id                  uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  kind                text not null check (kind = 'permit_updates'),
  source_name         text not null,
  source_sha256       text not null check (source_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  payload_fingerprint text not null check (payload_fingerprint ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  status              text not null check (status = 'completed'),
  row_count           int not null check (row_count > 0),
  actor               uuid not null references profiles(id),

);

alter table import_batches enable row level security;

create policy import_batches_read_she on import_batches for select to authenticated
using (
  has_role(array['she_staff']::app_role[])
  and exists (select 1 from profiles where id = auth.uid() and active)
);

create or replace function admin_import_permit_updates(p_envelope jsonb) returns uuid
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
declare
  v_actor uuid := auth.uid();
  v_source_name text;
  v_source_sha256 text;
  v_rows jsonb;
  v_payload_fingerprint text;
  v_existing import_batches%rowtype;
  v_row jsonb;
  v_row_number int;
  v_keys text[];
  v_seen jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  v_key text;
  v_batch_id uuid;
begin
  if v_actor is null or not exists (
    select 1
    from profiles profile
    join role_assignments assignment on assignment.user_id = profile.id
    where profile.id = v_actor
      and profile.active
      and assignment.role = 'she_staff'
      and assignment.scope = 'company'
  ) then
    raise exception '활성 SHE팀 담당자만 인허가를 일괄 반영할 수 있습니다.' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if jsonb_typeof(p_envelope) is distinct from 'object' then
    raise exception '가져오기 요청은 JSON 객체여야 합니다.';
  end if;

  select array_agg(key order by key) into v_keys from jsonb_object_keys(p_envelope) key;
  if v_keys is distinct from array['rows', 'source_name', 'source_sha256']::text[] then
    raise exception '가져오기 요청 필드가 계약과 일치하지 않습니다.';
  end if;

  if jsonb_typeof(p_envelope -> 'source_name') is distinct from 'string'
     or btrim(p_envelope ->> 'source_name') = ''
     or length(p_envelope ->> 'source_name') > 255 then
    raise exception 'source_name은 1자 이상 255자 이하 문자열이어야 합니다.';
  end if;
  if jsonb_typeof(p_envelope -> 'source_sha256') is distinct from 'string'
     or (p_envelope ->> 'source_sha256') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' then
    raise exception 'source_sha256은 소문자 64자리 SHA-256이어야 합니다.';
  end if;
  if jsonb_typeof(p_envelope -> 'rows') is distinct from 'array'
     or jsonb_array_length(p_envelope -> 'rows') = 0 then
    raise exception 'rows는 한 행 이상의 JSON 배열이어야 합니다.';
  end if;

  v_source_name := p_envelope ->> 'source_name';
  v_source_sha256 := p_envelope ->> 'source_sha256';
  v_rows := p_envelope -> 'rows';
  v_payload_fingerprint := encode(extensions.digest(v_rows::text, 'sha256'), 'hex');

  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('permit_updates:' || v_source_sha256, 0));
  select * into v_existing
  from import_batches
  where kind = 'permit_updates' and source_sha256 = v_source_sha256;

  if found then
    if v_existing.source_name is distinct from v_source_name
       or v_existing.payload_fingerprint is distinct from v_payload_fingerprint then
      raise exception '같은 원본 해시에 파일명 또는 인허가 내용이 다른 요청이 제출되었습니다.';
    end if;
    return v_existing.id;
  end if;

  for v_row, v_row_number in
    select value, ordinality::int from jsonb_array_elements(v_rows) with ordinality
  loop
    if jsonb_typeof(v_row) is distinct from 'object' then
      raise exception '데이터 %행은 JSON 객체여야 합니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;
    select array_agg(key order by key) into v_keys from jsonb_object_keys(v_row) key;
    if v_keys is distinct from array[
      'applicable', 'authority', 'conditions', 'detail', 'grade', 'issued_on',
      'items', 'permit_no', 'permit_type', 'quantity', 'site_code', 'status'
    ]::text[] then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 필드가 계약과 일치하지 않습니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;

    if jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'site_code') is distinct from 'string'
       or btrim(v_row ->> 'site_code') = ''
       or jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'permit_type') is distinct from 'string'
       or jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'applicable') is distinct from 'boolean'
       or jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'status') is distinct from 'string' then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 필수 값 형식이 올바르지 않습니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;

    if (v_row ->> 'permit_type') not in (select unnest(enum_range(null::permit_type))::text)
       or (v_row ->> 'status') not in (select unnest(enum_range(null::permit_status))::text) then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 인허가 유형 또는 상태가 허용되지 않습니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;

    if exists (
      select 1
      from unnest(array['grade', 'detail', 'permit_no', 'authority', 'conditions']) field
      where jsonb_typeof(v_row -> field) not in ('string', 'null')
    ) then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 선택 문자열 형식이 올바르지 않습니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;
    if exists (
      select 1
      from unnest(array['grade', 'detail', 'permit_no', 'authority', 'conditions']) field
      where jsonb_typeof(v_row -> field) = 'string' and btrim(v_row ->> field) = ''
    ) then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 선택 문자열은 비어 있거나 공백만 포함할 수 없습니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;

    if jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'items') is distinct from 'array'
       or exists (
         select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(v_row -> 'items') item
         where jsonb_typeof(item) is distinct from 'string' or btrim(item #>> '{}') = ''
       ) then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 대상 항목은 빈 값이 없는 문자열 배열이어야 합니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;

    if jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'quantity') not in ('number', 'null')
       or (
         jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'quantity') = 'number'
         and (
           (v_row ->> 'quantity') !~ '^-?(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$'
           or (v_row ->> 'quantity')::numeric not between -2147483648 and 2147483647
         )
       ) then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 수량은 32비트 정수 또는 null이어야 합니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;

    if jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'issued_on') not in ('string', 'null') then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 발급일은 유효한 YYYY-MM-DD 또는 null이어야 합니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;
    if jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'issued_on') = 'string' then
      if (v_row ->> 'issued_on') !~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' then
        raise exception '데이터 %행의 발급일은 유효한 YYYY-MM-DD 또는 null이어야 합니다.', v_row_number;
      end if;
      begin
        perform (v_row ->> 'issued_on')::date;
      exception
        when datetime_field_overflow or invalid_datetime_format then
          raise exception '데이터 %행의 발급일은 유효한 YYYY-MM-DD 또는 null이어야 합니다.', v_row_number;
      end;
    end if;

    v_key := (v_row ->> 'site_code') || chr(31) || (v_row ->> 'permit_type');
    if v_seen ? v_key then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 사업장·인허가 유형이 중복되었습니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;
    v_seen := v_seen || jsonb_build_object(v_key, true);

    if not exists (select 1 from sites where code = v_row ->> 'site_code') then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 사업장 코드가 등록되지 않았습니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;
    if not exists (
      select 1
      from site_permits permit
      join sites site on site.id = permit.site_id
      where site.code = v_row ->> 'site_code'
        and permit.permit_type::text = v_row ->> 'permit_type'
    ) then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 인허가 대상이 존재하지 않습니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;
  end loop;

  for v_row in select value from jsonb_array_elements(v_rows)
  loop
    update site_permits permit
    set applicable = (v_row ->> 'applicable')::boolean,
        grade = case when jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'grade') = 'string' then v_row ->> 'grade' else permit.grade end,
        detail = case when jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'detail') = 'string' then v_row ->> 'detail' else permit.detail end,
        items = case
          when jsonb_array_length(v_row -> 'items') > 0
            then array(select item #>> '{}' from jsonb_array_elements(v_row -> 'items') item)
          else permit.items
        end,
        quantity = case when jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'quantity') = 'number' then (v_row ->> 'quantity')::int else permit.quantity end,
        permit_no = case when jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'permit_no') = 'string' then v_row ->> 'permit_no' else permit.permit_no end,
        authority = case when jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'authority') = 'string' then v_row ->> 'authority' else permit.authority end,
        issued_on = case when jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'issued_on') = 'string' then (v_row ->> 'issued_on')::date else permit.issued_on end,
        conditions = case when jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'conditions') = 'string' then v_row ->> 'conditions' else permit.conditions end,
        status = (v_row ->> 'status')::permit_status,
        source = 'import:' || v_source_name || ':' || v_source_sha256,
        updated_by = v_actor,
        updated_at = now()
    from sites site
    where site.id = permit.site_id
      and site.code = v_row ->> 'site_code'
      and permit.permit_type::text = v_row ->> 'permit_type';
  end loop;

  insert into import_batches (
    kind, source_name, source_sha256, payload_fingerprint, status,
    row_count, actor, completed_at, error_summary
  ) values (
    'permit_updates', v_source_name, v_source_sha256, v_payload_fingerprint, 'completed',
    jsonb_array_length(v_rows), v_actor, now(), null
  ) returning id into v_batch_id;

  return v_batch_id;
end
$$;

create view v_admin_permit_status with (security_invoker = true) as

         when 'water_emission' then '폐수 배출시설'

         when 'river_water_use' then '하천수 사용'
         when 'waste_general' then '일반폐기물'
         when 'waste_designated' then '지정폐기물'
         when 'soil_specific' then '특정토양오염관리대상시설'

       end as permit_type_name,

       permit.grade,
       permit.permit_no,
       permit.authority,
       permit.issued_on,

from site_permits permit
join sites site on site.id = permit.site_id
join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
left join evidence on evidence.entity_id = permit.id;

create view v_admin_obligation_status with (security_invoker = true) as
with evidence as (
  select distinct attachment.entity_id
  from attachments attachment
  join storage.objects object
    on object.bucket_id = 'evidence'
   and object.name = attachment.storage_path
  where attachment.entity_type = 'obligation_task'
)
select task.id as task_id,
       site.id as site_id,
       site.code as site_code,
       site.name as site_name,
       division.code as division_code,
       division.name as division_name,
       type.code as obligation_type_code,
       type.title as obligation_title,
       task.period_label,
       task.due_date,
       task.due_date - (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date as d_day,
       task.status::text as status,
       case
         when task.status = 'planned' and task.due_date < (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date then '기한 경과'
         when task.status = 'planned' and task.due_date <= (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date + 30 then '기한 임박'
         when task.status = 'planned' then '계획'
         when task.status = 'done' then '이행 완료'
         when task.status = 'confirmed' then '확인 완료'
         when task.status = 'waived' then '면제'
       end as status_name,
       task.status = 'planned'
         and task.due_date < (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date as overdue,
       type.evidence_required,
       evidence.entity_id is not null as has_evidence,
       task.done_on,
       task.done_by,
       task.confirmed_by,
       task.confirmed_at
from obligation_tasks task
join obligation_types type on type.code = task.type_code
join sites site on site.id = task.site_id
join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
left join evidence on evidence.entity_id = task.id;

create view v_admin_era_status with (security_invoker = true) as
with item_counts as (
  select item.assessment_id,
         count(*) filter (where item.significant) as significant_item_count,
         count(*) filter (where item.needs_improvement) as improvement_item_count
  from era_items item
  group by item.assessment_id
),
evidence as (
  select distinct attachment.entity_id
  from attachments attachment
  join storage.objects object
    on object.bucket_id = 'evidence'
   and object.name = attachment.storage_path
  where attachment.entity_type = 'era_assessment'
)
select assessment.id as assessment_id,
       site.id as site_id,
       site.code as site_code,
       site.name as site_name,
       division.code as division_code,
       division.name as division_name,
       assessment.year as assessment_year,
       assessment.revision,
       assessment.template_id,
       assessment.status::text as status,
       case assessment.status
         when 'draft' then '초안'
         when 'submitted' then '제출'
         when 'reviewed' then '검토 완료'
         when 'approved' then '승인'
         when 'returned' then '반려'
       end as status_name,
       coalesce(item_counts.significant_item_count, 0) as significant_item_count,
       coalesce(item_counts.improvement_item_count, 0) as improvement_item_count,
       evidence.entity_id is not null as has_evidence,
       assessment.author_id,
       assessment.submitted_at,
       assessment.reviewed_at,
       assessment.approved_at,
       assessment.created_at
from era_assessments assessment
join sites site on site.id = assessment.site_id
join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
left join item_counts on item_counts.assessment_id = assessment.id
left join evidence on evidence.entity_id = assessment.id;

create view v_admin_action_status with (security_invoker = true) as
with evidence as (
  select distinct attachment.entity_id
  from attachments attachment
  join storage.objects object
    on object.bucket_id = 'evidence'
   and object.name = attachment.storage_path
  where attachment.entity_type in ('action_before', 'action_after')
)
select action.id as action_id,
       site.id as site_id,
       site.code as site_code,
       site.name as site_name,
       division.code as division_code,
       division.name as division_name,
       action.source_type::text as source_type,
       case action.source_type
         when 'era' then '환경영향평가'
         when 'finding' then '점검 지적'
         when 'incident' then '환경 사고'
         when 'obligation' then '의무 이행'
         when 'other' then '기타'
       end as source_type_name,
       action.source_id,
       action.title,
       action.owner_id,
       action.owner_name,
       action.due_date,
       action.due_date - (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date as d_day,
       action.status::text as status,
       case action.status
         when 'open' then '미착수'
         when 'in_progress' then '진행 중'
         when 'done' then '완료'
         when 'closed' then '종결'
         when 'returned' then '반려'
       end as status_name,
       action.status in ('open', 'in_progress', 'returned')

       action.confirmed_by is not null and action.confirmed_at is not null as manager_confirmed,

       evidence.entity_id is not null as has_evidence,
       action.created_at
from actions action
join sites site on site.id = action.site_id
join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
left join evidence on evidence.entity_id = action.id;

  from attachments attachment
  join storage.objects object
    on object.bucket_id = 'evidence'
   and object.name = attachment.storage_path
  where attachment.entity_type = 'obligation_task'
),
accessible_sites as (

  from sites site
),
unverified_obligations as (
  select 'obligation-type:' || type.code as issue_id,
         'warning'::text as severity,
         'unverified_legal_duty'::text as category,
         'obligation_type'::text as entity_type,

         null::uuid as site_id,
         null::text as site_code,
         null::text as site_name,
         null::text as division_code,

         concat_ws(' · ', type.title, type.legal_basis, type.notes) as detail
  from obligation_types type
  where not type.verified
    and exists (select 1 from accessible_sites)
),
permit_issues as (
  select 'site-permit:' || permit.id::text || ':' ||
           case when permit.status = 'unknown' then 'unknown' else 'missing' end as issue_id,
         'warning'::text as severity,
         case when permit.status = 'unknown' then 'unknown_permit_status' else 'missing_permit_data' end as category,
         'site_permit'::text as entity_type,
         permit.id::text as source_id,
         site.id as site_id,

         concat_ws(' · ', permit.permit_type::text, permit.source) as detail
  from site_permits permit
  join accessible_sites site on site.id = permit.site_id
  join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
  where permit.status = 'unknown'
     or (
       permit.applicable
       and permit.permit_no is null
       and permit.authority is null
       and permit.issued_on is null
     )
),
obligation_missing_evidence as (
  select 'obligation-task:' || task.id::text || ':missing-evidence' as issue_id,
         'error'::text as severity,
         'missing_evidence'::text as category,
         'obligation_task'::text as entity_type,
         task.id::text as source_id,
         site.id as site_id,
         site.code as site_code,
         site.name as site_name,
         division.code as division_code,
         division.name as division_name,
         '의무 이행 증빙 누락'::text as summary,
         type.title || ' · 기한 ' || task.due_date::text as detail
  from obligation_tasks task
  join obligation_types type on type.code = task.type_code
  join accessible_sites site on site.id = task.site_id
  join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
  left join obligation_evidence evidence on evidence.entity_id = task.id
  where type.evidence_required
    and task.status <> 'waived'
    and task.due_date <= (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date
    and evidence.entity_id is null
),
obligation_overdue as (
  select 'obligation-task:' || task.id::text || ':overdue' as issue_id,
         'error'::text as severity,
         'overdue_obligation'::text as category,
         'obligation_task'::text as entity_type,
         task.id::text as source_id,
         site.id as site_id,
         site.code as site_code,
         site.name as site_name,
         division.code as division_code,
         division.name as division_name,
         '의무 이행 기한 경과'::text as summary,
         type.title || ' · ' || ((now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date - task.due_date)::text || '일 경과' as detail
  from obligation_tasks task
  join obligation_types type on type.code = task.type_code
  join accessible_sites site on site.id = task.site_id
  join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
  where task.status = 'planned'
    and task.due_date < (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date
),
obligation_incomplete as (
