         'warning'::text as severity,
         'incomplete_obligation'::text as category,
         'obligation_task'::text as entity_type,
         task.id::text as source_id,
         site.id as site_id,
         site.code as site_code,
         site.name as site_name,
         division.code as division_code,
         division.name as division_name,
         '의무 이행 확인 미완료'::text as summary,
         type.title || ' · 이행 완료 후 공장장 확인 필요' as detail
  from obligation_tasks task
  join obligation_types type on type.code = task.type_code
  join accessible_sites site on site.id = task.site_id
  join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
  where task.status = 'done'
),
action_overdue as (
  select 'action:' || action.id::text || ':overdue' as issue_id,
         'error'::text as severity,
         'overdue_action'::text as category,
         'action'::text as entity_type,
         action.id::text as source_id,
         site.id as site_id,
         site.code as site_code,
         site.name as site_name,
         division.code as division_code,
         division.name as division_name,
         '조치 기한 경과'::text as summary,
         action.title || ' · ' || ((now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date - action.due_date)::text || '일 경과' as detail
  from actions action
  join accessible_sites site on site.id = action.site_id
  join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
  where action.status in ('open', 'in_progress', 'returned')
    and action.due_date < (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date
),
action_incomplete as (
  select 'action:' || action.id::text || ':incomplete' as issue_id,
         'warning'::text as severity,
         'incomplete_action'::text as category,
         'action'::text as entity_type,
         action.id::text as source_id,
         site.id as site_id,
         site.code as site_code,
         site.name as site_name,
         division.code as division_code,
         division.name as division_name,
         '조치 확인 또는 종결 미완료'::text as summary,
         action.title || ' · 현재 상태 ' || action.status::text as detail
  from actions action
  join accessible_sites site on site.id = action.site_id
  join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
  where action.status = 'done'
     or (action.status <> 'closed' and action.confirmed_at is not null)
)
select * from unverified_obligations
union all select * from permit_issues
union all select * from obligation_missing_evidence
union all select * from obligation_overdue
union all select * from obligation_incomplete
union all select * from action_overdue
union all select * from action_incomplete;

create or replace function admin_import_permit_updates(p_envelope jsonb) returns uuid
language plpgsql

set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$

  v_actor uuid := auth.uid();
  v_source_name text;
  v_source_sha256 text;
  v_rows jsonb;
  v_payload_fingerprint text;
  v_existing import_batches%rowtype;
  v_row jsonb;
  v_row_number int;
  v_keys text[];
  v_seen jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  v_key text;
  v_batch_id uuid;

    select 1
    from profiles profile
    join role_assignments assignment on assignment.user_id = profile.id
    where profile.id = v_actor
      and profile.active
      and assignment.role = 'she_staff'
      and assignment.scope = 'company'
  ) then

  end if;

    raise exception '가져오기 요청은 JSON 객체여야 합니다.';
  end if;

  select array_agg(key order by key) into v_keys from jsonb_object_keys(p_envelope) key;
  if v_keys is distinct from array['rows', 'source_name', 'source_sha256']::text[] then
    raise exception '가져오기 요청 필드가 계약과 일치하지 않습니다.';
  end if;

  if jsonb_typeof(p_envelope -> 'source_name') is distinct from 'string'
     or btrim(p_envelope ->> 'source_name') = ''
     or length(p_envelope ->> 'source_name') > 255 then
    raise exception 'source_name은 1자 이상 255자 이하 문자열이어야 합니다.';
  end if;
  if jsonb_typeof(p_envelope -> 'source_sha256') is distinct from 'string'
     or (p_envelope ->> 'source_sha256') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' then
    raise exception 'source_sha256은 소문자 64자리 SHA-256이어야 합니다.';
  end if;
  if jsonb_typeof(p_envelope -> 'rows') is distinct from 'array'
     or jsonb_array_length(p_envelope -> 'rows') = 0 then
    raise exception 'rows는 한 행 이상의 JSON 배열이어야 합니다.';
  end if;

  v_source_name := p_envelope ->> 'source_name';
  v_source_sha256 := p_envelope ->> 'source_sha256';
  v_rows := p_envelope -> 'rows';
  v_payload_fingerprint := encode(extensions.digest(v_rows::text, 'sha256'), 'hex');

  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('permit_updates:' || v_source_sha256, 0));
  select * into v_existing
  from import_batches
  where kind = 'permit_updates' and source_sha256 = v_source_sha256;

  if found then
    if v_existing.source_name is distinct from v_source_name
       or v_existing.payload_fingerprint is distinct from v_payload_fingerprint then
      raise exception '같은 원본 해시에 파일명 또는 인허가 내용이 다른 요청이 제출되었습니다.';
    end if;
    return v_existing.id;
  end if;

  for v_row, v_row_number in
    select value, ordinality::int from jsonb_array_elements(v_rows) with ordinality
  loop
    if jsonb_typeof(v_row) is distinct from 'object' then
      raise exception '데이터 %행은 JSON 객체여야 합니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;
    select array_agg(key order by key) into v_keys from jsonb_object_keys(v_row) key;
    if v_keys is distinct from array[
      'applicable', 'authority', 'conditions', 'detail', 'grade', 'issued_on',
      'items', 'permit_no', 'permit_type', 'quantity', 'site_code', 'status'
    ]::text[] then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 필드가 계약과 일치하지 않습니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;

    if jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'site_code') is distinct from 'string'
       or btrim(v_row ->> 'site_code') = ''
       or jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'permit_type') is distinct from 'string'
       or jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'applicable') is distinct from 'boolean'
       or jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'status') is distinct from 'string' then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 필수 값 형식이 올바르지 않습니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;

    if (v_row ->> 'permit_type') not in (select unnest(enum_range(null::permit_type))::text)
       or (v_row ->> 'status') not in (select unnest(enum_range(null::permit_status))::text) then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 인허가 유형 또는 상태가 허용되지 않습니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;

    if exists (
      select 1
      from unnest(array['grade', 'detail', 'permit_no', 'authority', 'conditions']) field
      where jsonb_typeof(v_row -> field) not in ('string', 'null')
    ) then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 선택 문자열 형식이 올바르지 않습니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;
    if exists (
      select 1
      from unnest(array['grade', 'detail', 'permit_no', 'authority', 'conditions']) field
      where jsonb_typeof(v_row -> field) = 'string' and btrim(v_row ->> field) = ''
    ) then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 선택 문자열은 비어 있거나 공백만 포함할 수 없습니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;

    if jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'items') is distinct from 'array'
       or exists (
         select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(v_row -> 'items') item
         where jsonb_typeof(item) is distinct from 'string' or btrim(item #>> '{}') = ''
       ) then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 대상 항목은 빈 값이 없는 문자열 배열이어야 합니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;

    if jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'quantity') not in ('number', 'null')
       or (
         jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'quantity') = 'number'
         and (
           (v_row ->> 'quantity') !~ '^-?(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$'
           or (v_row ->> 'quantity')::numeric not between -2147483648 and 2147483647
         )
       ) then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 수량은 32비트 정수 또는 null이어야 합니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;

    if jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'issued_on') not in ('string', 'null') then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 발급일은 유효한 YYYY-MM-DD 또는 null이어야 합니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;
    if jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'issued_on') = 'string' then
      if (v_row ->> 'issued_on') !~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' then
        raise exception '데이터 %행의 발급일은 유효한 YYYY-MM-DD 또는 null이어야 합니다.', v_row_number;
      end if;
      begin
        perform (v_row ->> 'issued_on')::date;
      exception
        when datetime_field_overflow or invalid_datetime_format then
          raise exception '데이터 %행의 발급일은 유효한 YYYY-MM-DD 또는 null이어야 합니다.', v_row_number;
      end;
    end if;

    v_key := (v_row ->> 'site_code') || chr(31) || (v_row ->> 'permit_type');
    if v_seen ? v_key then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 사업장·인허가 유형이 중복되었습니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;
    v_seen := v_seen || jsonb_build_object(v_key, true);

    if not exists (select 1 from sites where code = v_row ->> 'site_code') then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 사업장 코드가 등록되지 않았습니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;
    if not exists (
      select 1
      from site_permits permit
      join sites site on site.id = permit.site_id
      where site.code = v_row ->> 'site_code'
        and permit.permit_type::text = v_row ->> 'permit_type'
    ) then
      raise exception '데이터 %행의 인허가 대상이 존재하지 않습니다.', v_row_number;
    end if;
  end loop;

  for v_row in select value from jsonb_array_elements(v_rows)
  loop
    update site_permits permit
    set applicable = (v_row ->> 'applicable')::boolean,
        grade = case when jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'grade') = 'string' then v_row ->> 'grade' else permit.grade end,
        detail = case when jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'detail') = 'string' then v_row ->> 'detail' else permit.detail end,
        items = case
          when jsonb_array_length(v_row -> 'items') > 0
            then array(select item #>> '{}' from jsonb_array_elements(v_row -> 'items') item)
          else permit.items
        end,
        quantity = case when jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'quantity') = 'number' then (v_row ->> 'quantity')::int else permit.quantity end,
        permit_no = case when jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'permit_no') = 'string' then v_row ->> 'permit_no' else permit.permit_no end,
        authority = case when jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'authority') = 'string' then v_row ->> 'authority' else permit.authority end,
        issued_on = case when jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'issued_on') = 'string' then (v_row ->> 'issued_on')::date else permit.issued_on end,
        conditions = case when jsonb_typeof(v_row -> 'conditions') = 'string' then v_row ->> 'conditions' else permit.conditions end,
        status = (v_row ->> 'status')::permit_status,
        source = 'import:' || v_source_name || ':' || v_source_sha256,
        updated_by = v_actor,
        updated_at = now()
    from sites site
    where site.id = permit.site_id
      and site.code = v_row ->> 'site_code'
      and permit.permit_type::text = v_row ->> 'permit_type';
  end loop;

  insert into import_batches (
    kind, source_name, source_sha256, payload_fingerprint, status,
    row_count, actor, completed_at, error_summary
  ) values (
    'permit_updates', v_source_name, v_source_sha256, v_payload_fingerprint, 'completed',
    jsonb_array_length(v_rows), v_actor, now(), null
  ) returning id into v_batch_id;

  return v_batch_id;
end
$$;

revoke all on function admin_import_permit_updates(jsonb) from public;
revoke all on function admin_import_permit_updates(jsonb) from anon;
grant execute on function admin_import_permit_updates(jsonb) to authenticated;
create view v_admin_permit_status with (security_invoker = true) as
with evidence as (
  select distinct attachment.entity_id
  from attachments attachment
  join storage.objects object
    on object.bucket_id = 'evidence'
   and object.name = attachment.storage_path
  where attachment.entity_type = 'permit'
)
select permit.id as permit_id,
       site.id as site_id,
       site.code as site_code,
       site.name as site_name,
       division.code as division_code,
       division.name as division_name,
       permit.permit_type::text as permit_type,
       case permit.permit_type
         when 'air_emission' then '대기 배출시설'
         when 'air_prevention' then '대기 방지시설'
         when 'fugitive_dust' then '비산먼지 발생사업'
         when 'air_monitoring' then '대기 측정기기'
         when 'water_emission' then '폐수 배출시설'
         when 'nonpoint_source' then '비점오염원'
         when 'river_water_use' then '하천수 사용'
         when 'waste_general' then '일반폐기물'
         when 'waste_designated' then '지정폐기물'
         when 'soil_specific' then '특정토양오염관리대상시설'
         when 'noise_vibration' then '소음·진동 배출시설'
         when 'groundwater' then '지하수 이용'
         when 'chemical' then '화학물질 취급시설'
       end as permit_type_name,
       permit.applicable,
       permit.grade,
       permit.permit_no,
       permit.authority,
       permit.issued_on,
       permit.status::text as status,
       case permit.status
         when 'active' then '유효'
         when 'pending' then '확인 대기'
         when 'revoked' then '폐지'
         when 'unknown' then '미확인'
       end as status_name,
       permit.source,
       evidence.entity_id is not null as has_evidence,
       permit.status = 'unknown'
         or (
           permit.applicable
           and permit.permit_no is null
           and permit.authority is null
           and permit.issued_on is null
         ) as needs_review,
       permit.updated_at
from site_permits permit
join sites site on site.id = permit.site_id
join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
left join evidence on evidence.entity_id = permit.id;

create view v_admin_obligation_status with (security_invoker = true) as
with evidence as (
  select distinct attachment.entity_id
  from attachments attachment
  join storage.objects object
    on object.bucket_id = 'evidence'
   and object.name = attachment.storage_path
  where attachment.entity_type = 'obligation_task'
)
select task.id as task_id,
       site.id as site_id,
       site.code as site_code,
       site.name as site_name,
       division.code as division_code,
       division.name as division_name,
       type.code as obligation_type_code,
       type.title as obligation_title,
       task.period_label,
       task.due_date,
       task.due_date - (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date as d_day,
       task.status::text as status,
       case
         when task.status = 'planned' and task.due_date < (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date then '기한 경과'
         when task.status = 'planned' and task.due_date <= (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date + 30 then '기한 임박'
         when task.status = 'planned' then '계획'
         when task.status = 'done' then '이행 완료'
         when task.status = 'confirmed' then '확인 완료'
         when task.status = 'waived' then '면제'
       end as status_name,
       task.status = 'planned'
         and task.due_date < (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date as overdue,
       type.evidence_required,
       evidence.entity_id is not null as has_evidence,
       task.done_on,
       task.done_by,
       task.confirmed_by,
       task.confirmed_at
from obligation_tasks task
join obligation_types type on type.code = task.type_code
join sites site on site.id = task.site_id
join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
left join evidence on evidence.entity_id = task.id;

create view v_admin_era_status with (security_invoker = true) as
with item_counts as (
  select item.assessment_id,
         count(*) filter (where item.significant) as significant_item_count,
         count(*) filter (where item.needs_improvement) as improvement_item_count
  from era_items item
  group by item.assessment_id
),
evidence as (
  select distinct attachment.entity_id
  from attachments attachment
  join storage.objects object
    on object.bucket_id = 'evidence'
   and object.name = attachment.storage_path
  where attachment.entity_type = 'era_assessment'
)
select assessment.id as assessment_id,
       site.id as site_id,
       site.code as site_code,
       site.name as site_name,
       division.code as division_code,
       division.name as division_name,
       assessment.year as assessment_year,
       assessment.revision,
       assessment.template_id,
       assessment.status::text as status,
       case assessment.status
         when 'draft' then '초안'
         when 'submitted' then '제출'
         when 'reviewed' then '검토 완료'
         when 'approved' then '승인'
         when 'returned' then '반려'
       end as status_name,
       coalesce(item_counts.significant_item_count, 0) as significant_item_count,
       coalesce(item_counts.improvement_item_count, 0) as improvement_item_count,
       evidence.entity_id is not null as has_evidence,
       assessment.author_id,
       assessment.submitted_at,
       assessment.reviewed_at,
       assessment.approved_at,
       assessment.created_at
from era_assessments assessment
join sites site on site.id = assessment.site_id
join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
left join item_counts on item_counts.assessment_id = assessment.id
left join evidence on evidence.entity_id = assessment.id;

create view v_admin_action_status with (security_invoker = true) as
with evidence as (
  select distinct attachment.entity_id
  from attachments attachment
  join storage.objects object
    on object.bucket_id = 'evidence'
   and object.name = attachment.storage_path
  where attachment.entity_type in ('action_before', 'action_after')
)
select action.id as action_id,
       site.id as site_id,
       site.code as site_code,
       site.name as site_name,
       division.code as division_code,
       division.name as division_name,
       action.source_type::text as source_type,
       case action.source_type
         when 'era' then '환경영향평가'
         when 'finding' then '점검 지적'
         when 'incident' then '환경 사고'
         when 'obligation' then '의무 이행'
         when 'other' then '기타'
       end as source_type_name,
       action.source_id,
       action.title,
       action.owner_id,
       action.owner_name,
       action.due_date,
       action.due_date - (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date as d_day,
       action.status::text as status,
       case action.status
         when 'open' then '미착수'
         when 'in_progress' then '진행 중'
         when 'done' then '완료'
         when 'closed' then '종결'
         when 'returned' then '반려'
       end as status_name,
       action.status in ('open', 'in_progress', 'returned')
         and action.due_date < (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date as overdue,
       action.confirmed_by is not null and action.confirmed_at is not null as manager_confirmed,
       action.status = 'closed' and action.closed_by is not null and action.closed_at is not null as closed,
       evidence.entity_id is not null as has_evidence,
       action.created_at
from actions action
join sites site on site.id = action.site_id
join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
left join evidence on evidence.entity_id = action.id;

create view v_admin_data_quality with (security_invoker = true) as
with obligation_evidence as (
  select distinct attachment.entity_id
  from attachments attachment
  join storage.objects object
    on object.bucket_id = 'evidence'
   and object.name = attachment.storage_path
  where attachment.entity_type = 'obligation_task'
),
accessible_sites as (
  select site.id, site.code, site.name, site.division_code
  from sites site
),
unverified_obligations as (
  select 'obligation-type:' || type.code as issue_id,
         'warning'::text as severity,
         'unverified_legal_duty'::text as category,
         'obligation_type'::text as entity_type,
         type.code as source_id,
         null::uuid as site_id,
         null::text as site_code,
         null::text as site_name,
         null::text as division_code,
         null::text as division_name,
         '미검증 법적 의무'::text as summary,
         concat_ws(' · ', type.title, type.legal_basis, type.notes) as detail
  from obligation_types type
  where not type.verified
    and exists (select 1 from accessible_sites)
),
permit_issues as (
  select 'site-permit:' || permit.id::text || ':' ||
           case when permit.status = 'unknown' then 'unknown' else 'missing' end as issue_id,
         'warning'::text as severity,
         case when permit.status = 'unknown' then 'unknown_permit_status' else 'missing_permit_data' end as category,
         'site_permit'::text as entity_type,
         permit.id::text as source_id,
         site.id as site_id,
         site.code as site_code,
         site.name as site_name,
         division.code as division_code,
         division.name as division_name,
         case when permit.status = 'unknown' then '인허가 상태 미확인' else '인허가 필수정보 확인 필요' end as summary,
         concat_ws(' · ', permit.permit_type::text, permit.source) as detail
  from site_permits permit
  join accessible_sites site on site.id = permit.site_id
  join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
  where permit.status = 'unknown'
     or (
       permit.applicable
       and permit.permit_no is null
       and permit.authority is null
       and permit.issued_on is null
     )
),
obligation_missing_evidence as (
  select 'obligation-task:' || task.id::text || ':missing-evidence' as issue_id,
         'error'::text as severity,
         'missing_evidence'::text as category,
         'obligation_task'::text as entity_type,
         task.id::text as source_id,
         site.id as site_id,
         site.code as site_code,
         site.name as site_name,
         division.code as division_code,
         division.name as division_name,
         '의무 이행 증빙 누락'::text as summary,
         type.title || ' · 기한 ' || task.due_date::text as detail
  from obligation_tasks task
  join obligation_types type on type.code = task.type_code
  join accessible_sites site on site.id = task.site_id
  join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
  left join obligation_evidence evidence on evidence.entity_id = task.id
  where type.evidence_required
    and task.status <> 'waived'
    and task.due_date <= (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date
    and evidence.entity_id is null
),
obligation_overdue as (
  select 'obligation-task:' || task.id::text || ':overdue' as issue_id,
         'error'::text as severity,
         'overdue_obligation'::text as category,
         'obligation_task'::text as entity_type,
         task.id::text as source_id,
         site.id as site_id,
         site.code as site_code,
         site.name as site_name,
         division.code as division_code,
         division.name as division_name,
         '의무 이행 기한 경과'::text as summary,
         type.title || ' · ' || ((now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date - task.due_date)::text || '일 경과' as detail
  from obligation_tasks task
  join obligation_types type on type.code = task.type_code
  join accessible_sites site on site.id = task.site_id
  join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
  where task.status = 'planned'
    and task.due_date < (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date
),
obligation_incomplete as (
  select 'obligation-task:' || task.id::text || ':incomplete' as issue_id,
         'warning'::text as severity,
         'incomplete_obligation'::text as category,
         'obligation_task'::text as entity_type,
         task.id::text as source_id,
         site.id as site_id,
         site.code as site_code,
         site.name as site_name,
         division.code as division_code,
         division.name as division_name,
         '의무 이행 확인 미완료'::text as summary,
         type.title || ' · 이행 완료 후 공장장 확인 필요' as detail
  from obligation_tasks task
  join obligation_types type on type.code = task.type_code
  join accessible_sites site on site.id = task.site_id
  join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
  where task.status = 'done'
),
action_overdue as (
  select 'action:' || action.id::text || ':overdue' as issue_id,
         'error'::text as severity,
         'overdue_action'::text as category,
         'action'::text as entity_type,
         action.id::text as source_id,
         site.id as site_id,
         site.code as site_code,
         site.name as site_name,
         division.code as division_code,
         division.name as division_name,
         '조치 기한 경과'::text as summary,
         action.title || ' · ' || ((now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date - action.due_date)::text || '일 경과' as detail
  from actions action
  join accessible_sites site on site.id = action.site_id
  join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
  where action.status in ('open', 'in_progress', 'returned')
    and action.due_date < (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date
),
action_incomplete as (
  select 'action:' || action.id::text || ':incomplete' as issue_id,
         'warning'::text as severity,
         'incomplete_action'::text as category,
         'action'::text as entity_type,
         action.id::text as source_id,
         site.id as site_id,
         site.code as site_code,
         site.name as site_name,
         division.code as division_code,
         division.name as division_name,
         '조치 확인 또는 종결 미완료'::text as summary,
         action.title || ' · 현재 상태 ' || action.status::text as detail
  from actions action
  join accessible_sites site on site.id = action.site_id

    def respond(request: httpx2.Request) -> httpx2.Response:
        observed_headers.update(request.headers)

    client = ImportClient(

def test_import_client_does_not_retry_an_ambiguous_mutating_failure(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    # Given
    source = tmp_path / "permit_updates.csv"
    _write_csv(source)
    snapshot = read_permit_import_snapshot(source, frozenset((SiteCode("RMC-01"),)))
    request_count = 0
    transport_message = "response lost after request"
    access_token = "fixture-user-access-token-value"  # noqa: S105 - non-secret fixture

    def fail_after_request(request: httpx2.Request) -> httpx2.Response:
        nonlocal request_count
        request_count += 1
        raise httpx2.ReadError(transport_message, request=request)

    client = ImportClient(
        SupabaseConfig(
            url="https://project.supabase.co",
            project_key="fixture-project-anon-key-value",
            access_token=access_token,

        _ = client.apply_envelope(build_envelope(snapshot))
    assert request_count == 1
    assert "response lost" not in str(captured.value)
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import os
import socket
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from datetime import date
from typing import ClassVar, Final

import httpx2
import pytest
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, TypeAdapter

from scripts.importer.models import PermitUpdate, SiteCode
from scripts.importer.transaction import (
    ImportClient,
    ImportClientError,
    ImportEnvelope,
    SupabaseConfig,
)
from scripts.seed_builder.models import PermitStatus, PermitType

if os.environ.get("ERA_RUN_LOCAL_INTEGRATION") != "1":
    pytest.skip("local Supabase integration is opt-in", allow_module_level=True)

_LIMITS: Final = httpx2.Limits(
    max_connections=200,
    max_keepalive_connections=40,
    keepalive_expiry=30.0,
)
_TIMEOUT: Final = httpx2.Timeout(connect=5.0, read=30.0, write=10.0, pool=10.0)
_SOCKET_OPTIONS: Final = [(socket.IPPROTO_TCP, socket.TCP_NODELAY, 1)]


class _AuthSession(BaseModel):
    model_config: ClassVar[ConfigDict] = ConfigDict(frozen=True)

    access_token: str


class _BatchRow(BaseModel):
    model_config: ClassVar[ConfigDict] = ConfigDict(frozen=True)

    id: str


class _PermitRow(BaseModel):
    model_config: ClassVar[ConfigDict] = ConfigDict(frozen=True)

    detail: str | None


def _client(headers: dict[str, str]) -> httpx2.Client:
    transport = httpx2.HTTPTransport(
        http2=True,
        retries=3,
        limits=_LIMITS,
        socket_options=_SOCKET_OPTIONS,
    )
    return httpx2.Client(
        transport=transport,
        timeout=_TIMEOUT,
        follow_redirects=False,
        headers=headers,
    )


def _required_environment(name: str) -> str:
    value = os.environ.get(name, "").strip()
    if not value:
        pytest.fail(f"missing integration setting: {name}")
    return value


def _login(email: str) -> SupabaseConfig:
    url = _required_environment("SUPABASE_URL").rstrip("/")
    anon_key = _required_environment("SUPABASE_ANON_KEY")
    password = _required_environment("LOCAL_SUPABASE_TEST_PASSWORD")
    with _client({"apikey": anon_key, "Content-Type": "application/json"}) as client:
        response = client.post(
            f"{url}/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password",
            json={"email": email, "password": password},
        )
        _ = response.raise_for_status()
        session = _AuthSession.model_validate_json(response.content)
    return SupabaseConfig(
        url=url,
        project_key=anon_key,
        access_token=session.access_token,
    )


def _update(site_code: str, permit_type: PermitType, detail: str) -> PermitUpdate:
    return PermitUpdate(
        site_code=SiteCode(site_code),
        permit_type=permit_type,
        applicable=True,
        grade=None,
        detail=detail,
        items=(),
        quantity=None,
        permit_no=None,
        authority=None,
        issued_on=date(2026, 2, 3),
        conditions=None,
        status=PermitStatus.ACTIVE,
    )


def _envelope(label: str, rows: tuple[PermitUpdate, ...]) -> ImportEnvelope:
    return ImportEnvelope(
        source_name=f"{label}.csv",
        source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(label.encode()).hexdigest(),
        rows=rows,
    )


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "email",
    ["officer@example.test", "manager@example.test", "import-reader@example.test"],
)
def test_local_authenticated_non_she_roles_cannot_import(email: str) -> None:
    # Given
    config = _login(email)
    client = ImportClient(config)
    envelope = _envelope(f"denied-{email}", (_update("RMC-01", PermitType.AIR_EMISSION, "denied"),))

    # When / Then
    with pytest.raises(ImportClientError) as captured:
        _ = client.apply_envelope(envelope)
    assert "42501" in str(captured.value)
    assert "활성 SHE팀 담당자만" in str(captured.value)
    assert config.access_token not in str(captured.value)
    assert config.project_key not in str(captured.value)


def test_local_she_import_is_transactional_and_idempotent() -> None:
    # Given
    config = _login("she-staff@example.test")
    importer = ImportClient(config)
    valid = _envelope("integration-success", (_update("RMC-01", PermitType.AIR_EMISSION, "integration-ok"),))

    # When
    first_batch = importer.apply_envelope(valid)
    replay_batch = importer.apply_envelope(valid)

    # Then
    assert replay_batch == first_batch
    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {config.access_token}",
        "apikey": config.project_key,
    }
    with _client(headers) as client:
        batches_response = client.get(
            f"{config.url}/rest/v1/import_batches",
            params={"select": "id", "id": f"eq.{first_batch}"},
        )
        _ = batches_response.raise_for_status()
        batches = TypeAdapter(list[_BatchRow]).validate_json(batches_response.content)
        assert [row.id for row in batches] == [str(first_batch)]

        invalid = _envelope(
            "integration-rollback",
            (
                _update("RMC-01", PermitType.AIR_EMISSION, "must-not-persist"),
                _update("MOR-05", PermitType.CHEMICAL, "missing-target"),
            ),
        )
        with pytest.raises(ImportClientError):
            _ = importer.apply_envelope(invalid)

        permits_response = client.get(
            f"{config.url}/rest/v1/site_permits",
            params={
                "select": "detail,sites!inner(code)",
                "permit_type": "eq.air_emission",
                "sites.code": "eq.RMC-01",
            },
        )
        _ = permits_response.raise_for_status()
        permits = TypeAdapter(list[_PermitRow]).validate_json(permits_response.content)
        assert [row.detail for row in permits] == ["integration-ok"]


def test_local_concurrent_replay_returns_one_batch() -> None:
    # Given
    importer = ImportClient(_login("she-staff@example.test"))
    envelope = _envelope(
        "integration-concurrent",
        (_update("RMC-01", PermitType.AIR_PREVENTION, "concurrent-ok"),),
    )

    # When
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as executor:
        batch_ids = tuple(executor.map(importer.apply_envelope, (envelope, envelope)))

    # Then
    assert batch_ids[0] == batch_ids[1]

# Task 4 code review

## Scope and evidence inspected

- Goal: five `security_invoker` administrative views with RLS-safe operational reporting, stable data contracts, and documented CSV use.
- Diff: `2a7b255ba400a5bc08b0788ad700837846e5d533..3b7f3130e5b4cff7e7dd1a823ccd69bf4019a173`.
- Changed artifacts: `supabase/migrations/0012_admin_views.sql`, `supabase/tests/09_admin_views.test.sql`, and `docs/data-dictionary.md`.
- Task plan and ledger: `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-03-data-operations.md`, `.superpowers/sdd/2026-10-03-data-operations/progress.md`.
- Runtime evidence: `.omo/evidence/data-operations-task-4/green-reset.log`, `green-pgtap.log`, `manual-rest-csv-qa.json`, `summary.md`, and the five generated CSV files.

## Findings

CLEAR. No CRITICAL, IMPORTANT, MINOR, or test-quality finding.

### Security and correctness

- All five views are `security_invoker = true`; their base-table, CTE, aggregate, attachment, Storage, and division reads remain subject to the invoker's grants and RLS. They do not introduce a security-definer bypass.
- The pgTAP contracts assert all five exact ordered column interfaces, representative stable types, the `security_invoker` option, site/division/company scopes (1/14/23), no-role zero-row results, and anonymous privilege denial.
- `has_evidence` requires both a matching attachment and an `evidence` bucket object. The pre-existing attachment trigger/helper enforces site/entity/path binding, so the view cannot treat metadata alone as evidence. `distinct` evidence CTEs prevent multi-attachment row multiplication.
- Current enum mappings are exhaustive and non-null for every `permit_type`, `permit_status`, `task_status`, `era_status`, `action_source`, and `action_status` value declared in `0001_init.sql`.
- D-day and overdue logic consistently use `now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'`; the task test checks negative D-day, overdue workflow handling, and the action confirmation/closure indicators.
- Data-quality global legal-duty rows use null site columns and are produced only when the caller has an accessible site. This reports unverified definitions without asserting site applicability or creating schedules. Site-scoped rows are driven by the RLS-filtered `accessible_sites` CTE. Stable category-qualified IDs avoid union collisions.

### Documentation, evidence, and scale

- `docs/data-dictionary.md` matches the SQL columns, ordered contracts, types, Korean labels, D-day semantics, and quality categories.
- `manual-rest-csv-qa.json` records actual REST results for site/division/company users, 1/14/23 distinct-site scopes, and five company CSV exports. Each has a UTF-8 BOM, exact headers, Korean text, UUIDs, and site codes; Excel COM opened all five files with the expected grid dimensions.
- At the stated 23-site/299-permit scale, the per-view attachment/object scans and the few quality union scans are proportionate. The view queries use existing site/status and attachment entity indexes where the expected joins need them; no material repeated-row or cross-product risk was found.

## Validation note

The committed clean-run evidence records `pnpm db:reset` followed by `pnpm db:test` passing 10 files / 186 tests. I independently ran `pnpm db:test` without resetting the shared local runtime; it failed before TAP because the currently running database already contains the fixed fixture `auth.users` identities (`users_pkey` duplicate at `fixtures.sql:31`). This is local shared-state contamination after manual QA, not a Task 4 diff regression. I did not reset the shared runtime during a read-only review.

## Skill-perspective check

The `remove-ai-slops` and `programming` skill perspectives were loaded before review. The diff does not introduce prompt/tautological tests: pgTAP checks observable view schema, privileges, scoped result counts, and behavior. It contains no untyped escape hatch, needless runtime parser/normalizer, or speculative abstraction. The 364-line SQL migration is a single schema migration that necessarily owns all five view definitions and grants; splitting it would make review and migration ordering worse rather than improve cohesion.

## Verdict

- SPEC COMPLIANCE: PASS
- CODE QUALITY: CLEAR
- recommendation: APPROVE
- blockers: none

-- =========================================================
-- 4. M1 인허가
-- =========================================================
create table site_permits (
  id           uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  site_id      uuid not null references sites(id),
  permit_type  permit_type not null,
  applicable   boolean not null,             -- 취합표 O/X
  grade        text,                         -- '4종', '5종' 등
  detail       text,                         -- 처리방식, 비고(일부설비 면제 등)
  items        text[] not null default '{}', -- 폐기물 종류 목록
  quantity     int,                          -- 지하수 관정 수
  permit_no    text,
  authority    text,                         -- 허가·신고 기관
  issued_on    date,
  conditions   text,                         -- 허가조건
  status       permit_status not null default 'active',
  source       text not null default 'manual', -- 'seed:2026-07 취합표' 등
  updated_by   uuid references profiles(id),
  updated_at   timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique (site_id, permit_type)
);

create table permit_changes (
  id              uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  site_id         uuid not null references sites(id),
  permit_id       uuid references site_permits(id),
  change_kind     text not null check (change_kind in ('신규','변경신고','변경허가','폐지')),
  description     text not null,
  filed_on        date,
  approval_doc_no text,                      -- 전자결재 문서번호 (전결표 3번)
  created_by      uuid references profiles(id),
  created_at      timestamptz not null default now()
);

-- 환경기술인 선임 이력 (전결표 4번, 교육 의무의 기준일)
create table env_officer_appointments (
  id              uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  site_id         uuid not null references sites(id),
  person_name     text not null,
  profile_id      uuid references profiles(id),
  media           env_media[] not null default '{}', -- 대기·수질 등
  appointed_on    date not null,
  ended_on        date,
  new_edu_done_on date,                      -- 신규교육 이수일
  last_edu_done_on date,                     -- 최근 보수교육 이수일
  approval_doc_no text,
  created_at      timestamptz not null default now()
);

-- =========================================================
-- 5. M2 법적 준수
-- =========================================================
create table obligation_types (
  code              text primary key,
  media             env_media not null,
  title             text not null,
  legal_basis       text,
  description       text,
  source            obligation_source not null,
  frequency         frequency not null,
  times_per_period  int not null default 1,
  due_rule          jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb, -- {"day":15} {"month":2,"day":28}
  applies_when      jsonb not null,                     -- 적용 조건 (04_M2 참고)
  anchor            text not null default 'calendar' check (anchor in ('calendar','appointment')),
  evidence_required boolean not null default true,
  evidence_hint     text,
  owner_role        app_role not null default 'env_officer',
  confirm_role      app_role not null default 'plant_manager',
  verified          boolean not null default false,     -- false면 자동 일정 생성 금지
  verified_by       uuid references profiles(id),
  verified_at       timestamptz,
  notes             text
);

create table obligation_tasks (
  id            uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  site_id       uuid not null references sites(id),
  type_code     text not null references obligation_types(code),
  period_label  text not null,               -- '2027-1H', '2027-03' 등
  due_date      date not null,
  status        task_status not null default 'planned',
  done_on       date,
  done_by       uuid references profiles(id),
  confirmed_by  uuid references profiles(id),
  confirmed_at  timestamptz,
  waive_reason  text,
  note          text,
  created_at    timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique (site_id, type_code, due_date)
);

-- 화면용: 표시 상태 계산 (planned 중 D-30 이내 = due_soon, 기한 경과 = overdue)
create or replace view v_obligation_tasks with (security_invoker = true) as
select t.*,
       ot.title, ot.media, ot.verified,
       s.name as site_name, s.division_code,
       case
         when t.status in ('done','confirmed','waived') then t.status::text
         when t.due_date < (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date then 'overdue'
         when t.due_date <= (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date + 30 then 'due_soon'
         else 'planned'
       end as display_status
from obligation_tasks t
join obligation_types ot on ot.code = t.type_code
join sites s on s.id = t.site_id;

-- 적용 조건 판정
create or replace function obligation_applies(p_site uuid, p_rule jsonb) returns boolean
language plpgsql stable as $$
declare
  v_ok boolean;
begin
  if coalesce((p_rule->>'all_sites')::boolean, false) then
    return true;
  end if;
  select exists (
    select 1 from site_permits p
    where p.site_id = p_site
      and p.applicable
      and p.permit_type = (p_rule->>'permit_type')::permit_type
      and (not (p_rule ? 'grade_in')
           or p.grade = any (array(select jsonb_array_elements_text(p_rule->'grade_in'))))
      and (not (p_rule ? 'detail_excludes')
           or coalesce(p.detail,'') not ilike '%' || (p_rule->>'detail_excludes') || '%')
      and (not (p_rule ? 'detail_includes')
           or coalesce(p.detail,'') ilike '%' || (p_rule->>'detail_includes') || '%')
  ) into v_ok;
  return v_ok;
end $$;

-- 달력 기준 의무 일정 생성 (verified 항목만). 여러 번 실행해도 중복 생성하지 않는다.
create or replace function generate_obligation_tasks(p_year int) returns int
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare
  r_site record; r_type record;
  v_dates date[]; v_labels text[]; d date; i int; m int; v_count int := 0; v_day int;
begin
  for r_type in select * from obligation_types where verified and anchor = 'calendar' and frequency <> 'event' and frequency <> 'triennial' loop
    v_dates := '{}'; v_labels := '{}';
    v_day := nullif(r_type.due_rule->>'day','')::int;
    if r_type.frequency = 'weekly' then
      d := make_date(p_year,1,1) + ((7 - extract(dow from make_date(p_year,1,1))::int) % 7); -- 첫 일요일
      while extract(year from d) = p_year loop
        v_dates := v_dates || d; v_labels := v_labels || to_char(d,'IYYY-"W"IW'); d := d + 7;
      end loop;
    elsif r_type.frequency = 'monthly' then
      for m in 1..12 loop
        if r_type.times_per_period = 2 then
          v_dates := v_dates || make_date(p_year,m,15); v_labels := v_labels || format('%s-%s-1', p_year, lpad(m::text,2,'0'));
          v_dates := v_dates || (make_date(p_year,m,1) + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date; v_labels := v_labels || format('%s-%s-2', p_year, lpad(m::text,2,'0'));
        elsif v_day is not null then
          v_dates := v_dates || make_date(p_year,m,v_day); v_labels := v_labels || format('%s-%s', p_year, lpad(m::text,2,'0'));
        else
          v_dates := v_dates || (make_date(p_year,m,1) + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date; v_labels := v_labels || format('%s-%s', p_year, lpad(m::text,2,'0'));
        end if;
      end loop;
    elsif r_type.frequency = 'bimonthly' then
      for m in 2..12 by 2 loop
        v_dates := v_dates || (make_date(p_year,m,1) + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date; v_labels := v_labels || format('%s-B%s', p_year, m/2);
      end loop;
    elsif r_type.frequency = 'quarterly' then
      for i in 1..4 loop
        v_dates := v_dates || (make_date(p_year,i*3,1) + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date; v_labels := v_labels || format('%s-Q%s', p_year, i);
      end loop;
    elsif r_type.frequency = 'semiannual' then
      v_dates := array[make_date(p_year,6,30), make_date(p_year,12,31)];
      v_labels := array[format('%s-1H',p_year), format('%s-2H',p_year)];
    elsif r_type.frequency = 'annual' then
      v_dates := array[make_date(p_year, coalesce((r_type.due_rule->>'month')::int,12),
                                         coalesce(v_day, case when coalesce((r_type.due_rule->>'month')::int,12) = 2 then 28 else 31 end))];
      v_labels := array[p_year::text];
    end if;

    for r_site in select id from sites where active loop
      if obligation_applies(r_site.id, r_type.applies_when) then
        for i in 1..coalesce(array_length(v_dates,1),0) loop
          insert into obligation_tasks(site_id, type_code, period_label, due_date)
          values (r_site.id, r_type.code, v_labels[i], v_dates[i])
          on conflict (site_id, type_code, due_date) do nothing;
          if found then v_count := v_count + 1; end if;
        end loop;
      end if;
    end loop;
  end loop;
  return v_count;
end $$;

def _required_environment(name: str) -> str:

def _login(email: str) -> SupabaseConfig:
    url = _required_environment("SUPABASE_URL").rstrip("/")
    anon_key = _required_environment("SUPABASE_ANON_KEY")
    password = _required_environment("LOCAL_SUPABASE_TEST_PASSWORD")
    with _client({"apikey": anon_key, "Content-Type": "application/json"}) as client:
        response = client.post(
            f"{url}/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password",
            json={"email": email, "password": password},
        )
        _ = response.raise_for_status()
        session = _AuthSession.model_validate_json(response.content)
    return SupabaseConfig(
        url=url,
        project_key=anon_key,
        access_token=session.access_token,
    )

-- 환경기술인 선임 이력 (전결표 4번, 교육 의무의 기준일)
create table env_officer_appointments (

);

-- =========================================================
-- 5. M2 법적 준수
-- =========================================================
create table obligation_types (
  code              text primary key,
  media             env_media not null,
  title             text not null,
  legal_basis       text,
  description       text,
  source            obligation_source not null,
  frequency         frequency not null,
  times_per_period  int not null default 1,
  due_rule          jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb, -- {"day":15} {"month":2,"day":28}
  applies_when      jsonb not null,                     -- 적용 조건 (04_M2 참고)
  anchor            text not null default 'calendar' check (anchor in ('calendar','appointment')),
  evidence_required boolean not null default true,
  evidence_hint     text,
  owner_role        app_role not null default 'env_officer',
  confirm_role      app_role not null default 'plant_manager',
  verified          boolean not null default false,     -- false면 자동 일정 생성 금지
  verified_by       uuid references profiles(id),
  verified_at       timestamptz,
  notes             text
);

create table obligation_tasks (
  id            uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  site_id       uuid not null references sites(id),
  type_code     text not null references obligation_types(code),
  period_label  text not null,               -- '2027-1H', '2027-03' 등
  due_date      date not null,
  status        task_status not null default 'planned',
  done_on       date,
  done_by       uuid references profiles(id),
  confirmed_by  uuid references profiles(id),
  confirmed_at  timestamptz,
  waive_reason  text,
  note          text,
  created_at    timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique (site_id, type_code, due_date)
);

-- 화면용: 표시 상태 계산 (planned 중 D-30 이내 = due_soon, 기한 경과 = overdue)
create or replace view v_obligation_tasks with (security_invoker = true) as
select t.*,
       ot.title, ot.media, ot.verified,
       s.name as site_name, s.division_code,
       case
         when t.status in ('done','confirmed','waived') then t.status::text
         when t.due_date < (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date then 'overdue'
         when t.due_date <= (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date + 30 then 'due_soon'
         else 'planned'
       end as display_status
from obligation_tasks t
join obligation_types ot on ot.code = t.type_code
join sites s on s.id = t.site_id;

-- 적용 조건 판정
create or replace function obligation_applies(p_site uuid, p_rule jsonb) returns boolean
language plpgsql stable as $$
declare
  v_ok boolean;
begin
  if coalesce((p_rule->>'all_sites')::boolean, false) then
    return true;
  end if;
  select exists (
    select 1 from site_permits p
    where p.site_id = p_site
      and p.applicable
      and p.permit_type = (p_rule->>'permit_type')::permit_type
      and (not (p_rule ? 'grade_in')
           or p.grade = any (array(select jsonb_array_elements_text(p_rule->'grade_in'))))
      and (not (p_rule ? 'detail_excludes')
           or coalesce(p.detail,'') not ilike '%' || (p_rule->>'detail_excludes') || '%')
      and (not (p_rule ? 'detail_includes')
           or coalesce(p.detail,'') ilike '%' || (p_rule->>'detail_includes') || '%')
  ) into v_ok;
  return v_ok;
end $$;

-- 달력 기준 의무 일정 생성 (verified 항목만). 여러 번 실행해도 중복 생성하지 않는다.
create or replace function generate_obligation_tasks(p_year int) returns int
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare
  r_site record; r_type record;
  v_dates date[]; v_labels text[]; d date; i int; m int; v_count int := 0; v_day int;
begin
  for r_type in select * from obligation_types where verified and anchor = 'calendar' and frequency <> 'event' and frequency <> 'triennial' loop
    v_dates := '{}'; v_labels := '{}';
    v_day := nullif(r_type.due_rule->>'day','')::int;
    if r_type.frequency = 'weekly' then
      d := make_date(p_year,1,1) + ((7 - extract(dow from make_date(p_year,1,1))::int) % 7); -- 첫 일요일
      while extract(year from d) = p_year loop
        v_dates := v_dates || d; v_labels := v_labels || to_char(d,'IYYY-"W"IW'); d := d + 7;
      end loop;
    elsif r_type.frequency = 'monthly' then
      for m in 1..12 loop
        if r_type.times_per_period = 2 then
          v_dates := v_dates || make_date(p_year,m,15); v_labels := v_labels || format('%s-%s-1', p_year, lpad(m::text,2,'0'));
          v_dates := v_dates || (make_date(p_year,m,1) + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date; v_labels := v_labels || format('%s-%s-2', p_year, lpad(m::text,2,'0'));
        elsif v_day is not null then
          v_dates := v_dates || make_date(p_year,m,v_day); v_labels := v_labels || format('%s-%s', p_year, lpad(m::text,2,'0'));
        else
          v_dates := v_dates || (make_date(p_year,m,1) + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date; v_labels := v_labels || format('%s-%s', p_year, lpad(m::text,2,'0'));
        end if;
      end loop;
    elsif r_type.frequency = 'bimonthly' then
      for m in 2..12 by 2 loop
        v_dates := v_dates || (make_date(p_year,m,1) + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date; v_labels := v_labels || format('%s-B%s', p_year, m/2);
      end loop;
    elsif r_type.frequency = 'quarterly' then
      for i in 1..4 loop
        v_dates := v_dates || (make_date(p_year,i*3,1) + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date; v_labels := v_labels || format('%s-Q%s', p_year, i);
      end loop;
    elsif r_type.frequency = 'semiannual' then
      v_dates := array[make_date(p_year,6,30), make_date(p_year,12,31)];
      v_labels := array[format('%s-1H',p_year), format('%s-2H',p_year)];
    elsif r_type.frequency = 'annual' then
      v_dates := array[make_date(p_year, coalesce((r_type.due_rule->>'month')::int,12),
                                         coalesce(v_day, case when coalesce((r_type.due_rule->>'month')::int,12) = 2 then 28 else 31 end))];
      v_labels := array[p_year::text];
    end if;

    for r_site in select id from sites where active loop
      if obligation_applies(r_site.id, r_type.applies_when) then
        for i in 1..coalesce(array_length(v_dates,1),0) loop
          insert into obligation_tasks(site_id, type_code, period_label, due_date)
          values (r_site.id, r_type.code, v_labels[i], v_dates[i])
          on conflict (site_id, type_code, due_date) do nothing;
          if found then v_count := v_count + 1; end if;
        end loop;
      end if;
    end loop;
  end loop;
  return v_count;
end $$;

content.text:
Three concrete Important (P2) findings:

1. **Seed validation accepts values rejected by the database.** `scripts/seed_builder/models.py:127` and `:132` declare `source` and `anchor` as unrestricted strings. In-memory substitution of `not_a_source` / `not_an_anchor` into the real CSV yielded `issues=()` and generated SQL containing those literals. `source` is PostgreSQL enum `obligation_source` (`law`,`internal`); a read-only live cast reproduced its rejection. `anchor` has a CHECK permitting only `calendar`,`appointment`. Thus regeneration can overwrite valid seed SQL with an artifact that cannot load, without the required row/field diagnostic. Spec `docs/spec/11_backend_mvp.md:75–76`: “입력 파일의 스키마, 필수값, enum 값 … 검사한 뒤 SQL을 만든다.”

2. **Malformed seed CSV structure silently loses values.** `scripts/seed_builder/readers.py:32–43` checks only missing headers and discards `DictReader`’s extra-cell entry. Appending `,UNEXPECTED` to the first real `sites.csv` data row still produced SQL with zero issues. Duplicate `name` headers also returned zero issues and selected `REPLACEMENT` over `ORIGINAL`. Reject surplus cells and duplicate headers before constructing records. Spec `11_backend_mvp.md:75–76` requires schema validation; `:90–91` requires rejection and actionable diagnostics for erroneous rows.

3. **Known source gaps are absent from the quality view.** `supabase/migrations/0012_admin_views.sql:244–249` includes only unknown status or applicable permits missing all three legal fields. The existing `seed/data_gaps.md:5` identifies RMC-05’s pending waste declaration; live read-only SQL returned `RMC-05|waste_general|false|pending|0` quality findings. The known MOR-03 typo is represented only by generic missing metadata, without its actual source issue. Spec `11_backend_mvp.md:96`: “데이터 공백과 원본 오기는 … 품질 관리 뷰에 노출한다.”

Baseline generation remains **23/299/22/18/35**. Inspected existing real Auth/import/concurrency and five-view REST/CSV/Excel QA; no broad suite rerun or state changes.

Completeness limitation: plan 4’s operations commands, backup/restore verification, runbook and full operator E2E remain absent. Roadmap explicitly reserves the final release gate for that plan; spec `:272` is therefore unmet independently of these implementation findings.
